agent.jobTitle: Commission Agent & Broker — Mandi, Vehicles, Land & Rentals
agent.tagline: Fair deals, clean papers, commission told first
agent.about: We are a licensed commission agent working out of the new grain mandi and the main market of our city, for farmers, traders, families and small businesses who want a deal done properly. From selling a season's wheat at the right bid to finding a buyer for a used tractor, a tenant for a shop or a clean plot to buy, we bring genuine parties together, negotiate the rate of the day and get every paper signed, stamped and receipted. Our commission is told before any work starts, we never represent both sides without saying so, and you get an update at every step until the money and the goods have changed hands. The trust of the same families for years is the only reason the next deal comes to us.

products.name: Mandi Sale of Grain & Pulses (Arhat)
products.desc: Bring your wheat, mustard, gram, soybean or paddy to our arhat shop in the mandi. We get it unloaded, cleaned and graded, put it up in the open auction, hold the bid for you and pay you the full amount against the mandi slip — same day for most lots.
features: Unloading, cleaning and weighing on the electronic kanta in front of you
Open auction with the day's registered traders; you accept or refuse the bid
Payment to your bank account the same day or next working day with the mandi J-form
Gunny bags, labour and weighing charges listed separately on the slip, no hidden cuts

specs.label: Commission
specs.value: 2% of sale value, as per mandi board rate

specs.label: Minimum lot
specs.value: 10 quintals; smaller lots clubbed on request

specs.label: Payment
specs.value: Bank transfer against J-form, same day for cleared lots

products.name: Used Tractor & Farm Equipment Deal
products.desc: Buying or selling a used tractor, rotavator, thresher or harvester? We inspect the machine with a mechanic, check the RC and loan status, fix a fair rate from the week's market, and complete the transfer at the RTO so no notice ever comes to the old owner.
features: Mechanic inspection of engine, clutch, hydraulics and tyres before the price is fixed
RC, insurance, hypothecation and challan check on the government portal
Form 29/30 and NOC done; transfer slip handed over to both parties
Buyer financing through the local bank or NBFC branch arranged on request

specs.label: Fee
specs.value: ₹5,000 flat, split between buyer and seller as agreed

specs.label: Typical range
specs.value: Tractors ₹2.5 lakh to ₹8 lakh; implements from ₹25,000

specs.label: Time
specs.value: Inspection in 2 days; RTO transfer in 7 to 10 working days

products.name: Used Car & Two-Wheeler Buy–Sell
products.desc: Genuine owner-driven cars and bikes from families we know, with service record, insurance and RC checked. You pay the seller directly; we handle inspection, test drive, price talk and the ownership transfer.
features: Only single-owner, no-accident vehicles listed; history checked on the insurer portal
Test drive arranged at your convenience with the owner present
Price negotiated with reference to the week's market, and shared with both parties in writing
RC transfer, insurance transfer and pending-challan clearance included in the fee

specs.label: Transfer time
specs.value: RC in the buyer's name within 10 to 15 working days

products.name: Plot & Agricultural Land Deal
products.desc: Residential plots in approved colonies and farmland on the highway side, shown only after we have seen the khasra, the title chain and the encumbrance ourselves. Agreement to sale, stamp paper, registry at the tehsil and mutation are coordinated end to end.
features: Khasra, khatauni, title chain and approved-layout check before you are shown the land
Site visit with the owner and a boundary walk; measurement by a licensed surveyor on request
Agreement to sale drafted by our empanelled advocate; registry slot booked at the tehsil
Mutation (dakhil-kharij) followed up until the record is in your name

specs.label: Commission
specs.value: 1% of deal value from buyer and 1% from seller

specs.label: Current listings
specs.value: Plots from ₹6 lakh (900 sq ft); farmland from ₹18 lakh per bigha

specs.label: Advance
specs.value: Token to owner only against a written receipt we prepare

products.name: Shop & Godown on Rent — Owner-Tenant Matching
products.desc: Shops on the main market road, godowns near the mandi and small office rooms, matched to tenants who will pay on time. Both sides meet at our office, terms are written down the same day and the agreement is registered where the rent requires it.
features: Owners verified by registry or electricity bill; tenants by Aadhaar and trade references
Rent, deposit, increment and notice period fixed in writing before keys are handed over
Agreement drafted, notarised or registered as the law requires for the term
Handover checklist with meter readings and photos, signed by both parties

specs.label: Commission
specs.value: 15 days' rent from the owner, 15 days' rent from the tenant

specs.label: Current rents
specs.value: Shops ₹8,000 to ₹35,000 per month; godowns from ₹12 per sq ft

specs.label: Typical term
specs.value: 11 months, renewable; 3-year registered lease for godowns

products.name: Rent Agreement & Property Paperwork
products.desc: If you have already found your own tenant, buyer or seller, we do only the paperwork: rent agreement on the correct stamp paper, agreement to sale, affidavit, NOC, power of attorney, and registry coordination with the tehsil office.
features: Rent agreement on the right stamp value, notarised the same day
Agreement to sale and sale deed drafted by our empanelled advocate
Registry appointment booked, witnesses arranged, stamp duty calculated for you
Soft copy and a stamped hard copy for each party

specs.label: Rent agreement
specs.value: ₹2,500 including stamp paper up to ₹100 and notary

specs.label: Turnaround
specs.value: Same day for rent agreement; 3 to 5 days for registry

products.name: Vehicle RC Transfer, NOC & Insurance Renewal
products.desc: Bought a vehicle on your own, or moving to another state? We complete the RC transfer, hypothecation removal after loan closure, duplicate RC, address change and NOC at the RTO, and renew insurance and PUC so you are never caught at a checkpoint.
features: Form 29, 30, 35 and NOC filled and filed with original verification
Hypothecation removal after your bank's loan-closure letter
Pending challans checked and cleared before filing
Smart-card RC delivered to your door by post or hand

specs.label: Service fee
specs.value: ₹1,800 for RC transfer; ₹1,200 for HP removal; plus actual RTO fee

specs.label: Documents
specs.value: RC, insurance, PUC, Aadhaar of both parties, sale affidavit

products.name: Produce Lifting & Transport Arrangement
products.desc: For farmers and traders who need a truck or tractor-trolley to lift produce from the field or godown to the mandi, mill or buyer's warehouse. We book a known transporter at the day's rate, arrange loading labour, and send you the weighment slip and bilty on WhatsApp.
features: Tractor-trolley for 40 to 60 quintals; 6, 10 and 14-wheel trucks for larger lots
Loading labour, tarpaulin and gunny bags arranged at mandi rates
Weighbridge slip and bilty shared on WhatsApp before the vehicle moves
Direct lifting to mills and warehouses in neighbouring districts

specs.label: Rate
specs.value: Per quintal or per trip at the day's transport rate, quoted before booking

specs.label: Booking
specs.value: One day's notice; same-day in the auction season where a vehicle is free

specs.label: Payment
specs.value: To the transporter directly on delivery; our service charge on the slip

services.name: Buyer–seller matching
services.desc: We bring verified buyers and sellers of produce, vehicles, plots and shops together, and say clearly whom we are working for.

services.name: Rate negotiation
services.desc: The day's mandi bid, the week's vehicle market, the colony's plot rate — we know them and negotiate a fair price in the open.

services.name: Verification before the deal
services.desc: Khasra and title for land, RC and loan status for vehicles, owner and tenant identity for rentals, checked before you meet.

services.name: Paperwork and registration
services.desc: Agreements, affidavits, RTO forms, mandi slips and registry documents prepared, explained and signed in front of you.

services.name: Payment coordination
services.desc: Deal money moves directly between the parties by bank transfer; we match every payment to a receipt so both sides see the same figures.

services.name: Follow-up till closure and after
services.desc: RC in your name, mutation in the record, deposit returned on vacating — we stay on it until it is done, and take up any complaint with the other side.

offer.title: Rabi Season: Half commission on your first mandi lot
offer.text: Farmers bringing their first lot to our arhat this season pay 1% instead of 2% on that sale, with same-day payment and free cleaning. Message your village and crop to register.

reviews.name: Mahendra, farmer, Rampura
reviews.text: Sold 85 quintals of mustard through his arhat. The bid was ₹40 above the other shop and the money reached my account the same evening with the J-form on WhatsApp. He explained the labour and bag charges before unloading, so there was no argument at the slip.

reviews.name: Sunita D., shop owner
reviews.text: Found a tenant for my shop on Station Road within two weeks. He checked the tenant's references himself, wrote the agreement with the increment clause and the handover photos, and took only the 15 days' rent he had said at the start.

reviews.name: Imran, bought a used tractor
reviews.text: Took a mechanic along for the inspection and found a clutch issue the seller had not mentioned; the price came down by ₹30,000. The RC came in my name in twelve days. Would have liked the RTO visit to be a little quicker, but every paper was right.

faq.q: How much is your commission, and when do I pay it?
faq.a: It depends on the deal: 2% of sale value on mandi produce, 1% on vehicles and land, 15 days' rent on rentals, and fixed fees for paperwork-only work. We tell you the exact figure on WhatsApp before any work starts, and you pay only when the deal is complete, against a receipt.

faq.q: Who pays the commission — the buyer or the seller?
faq.a: In the mandi the seller pays through the slip. For land and shop rentals both sides pay their share. For vehicles usually the seller pays. We confirm this in writing at the beginning so nobody is surprised at the end.

faq.q: Are you a licensed agent?
faq.a: Yes. We hold a commission agent licence from the Krishi Upaj Mandi Samiti, and every mandi sale is recorded in the mandi's own J-form. Ask at the shop and we show you the licence; you can also check it at the mandi office.

faq.q: Do you handle all the paperwork, or do I need my own lawyer?
faq.a: We prepare rent agreements, affidavits, RTO forms and mandi slips ourselves. Sale deeds and agreements to sale are drafted by our empanelled advocate, and you are welcome to have your own lawyer read everything before you sign — we encourage it.

faq.q: I live in another city. Can you handle the deal for me?
faq.a: Yes, for most deals. Videos of the land, vehicle or shop, documents on WhatsApp, payment by bank transfer, and a registered power of attorney where a signature is needed in person. You will need to come once for a registry at the tehsil; everything else can be done remotely.

faq.q: What if the deal falls through after the work has started?
faq.a: No commission is due if a deal does not close. If a token or advance has been paid, it is returned or forfeited exactly as written in the receipt we prepared at the time, so there is no dispute later.

agent.address: Shop 4, Arhat Line, New Grain Mandi, near Krishi Upaj Mandi Gate No. 2

agent.botKnowledge: Can explain each deal type and its commission or fee (mandi arhat 2%, vehicles 1% with ₹2,500 minimum, land 1% from each side, rentals 15 days' rent, rent agreement ₹2,500, RC transfer ₹1,800 plus RTO fee), the documents needed for each, who pays, typical timelines for inspection, RTO transfer, registry and mutation, the current rabi season offer, shop and mandi hours, the address near Mandi Gate No. 2, and what to send on WhatsApp to start (crop and quantity, vehicle details and RC photo, or property location and budget). It does not quote the day's mandi rate or a property price; it takes the requirement and promises a call-back with options and the going rate.

agri.jobTitle: Seeds, Fertiliser, Crop Protection & Farm Equipment — Krishi Seva Kendra
agri.tagline: Right seed, right dose, right time
agri.about: We are a krishi seva kendra on the mandi road, supplying seeds, fertiliser, crop-protection products, sprayers and drip material to farmers of the villages around the city for kharif, rabi and the vegetable seasons in between. Every packet and bag on our shelf is company-sealed stock bought from the authorised distributor, checked for lot number and expiry before it goes out, and billed on a GST invoice so you have proof of what you sowed. Our counter staff are farmers' sons who know the soil here; tell us the crop, the land and the problem and we tell you what to use, how much per acre and when, not just what is in stock. Season bookings, delivery to the village on our own loader, sprayer repair and help with soil-test and subsidy forms are all part of the same shop.

products.name: Bt Cotton Hybrid Seed (BG-II), 475 g packet
products.desc: Government-approved Bt cotton hybrid suited to the black and medium soils of this belt, for sowing with the first monsoon rain. One packet sows one acre at the recommended spacing.
features: Sealed company packet with lot number, batch and expiry printed
Treated seed, ready to sow; refuge seed packet included as per rule
Spacing, dose and first-spray schedule explained at the counter
Book early in May; cotton seed runs short by mid-June

specs.label: Sowing
specs.value: June – early July, with first rain or on irrigation

products.name: Certified Wheat Seed, 40 kg bag (HD-3086 / DBW-187 type)
products.desc: Certified seed of high-tillering, rust-tolerant wheat varieties released for this zone, graded and tagged. One bag covers one acre at normal sowing.
features: Blue certification tag on every bag; germination tested for the current season
Graded bold grain, free of weed seed and broken kernels
Variety chosen with you for timely or late sowing
Seed treatment (fungicide) available at the shop on request

specs.label: Sowing
specs.value: 1 – 25 November timely; late-sown types till 15 December

specs.label: Seed rate
specs.value: 40 kg per acre, 50 kg if sown late

products.name: Hybrid Tomato Seed, 10 g
products.desc: Determinate hybrid tomato for open-field planting, firm round fruit of 90 – 100 g that travels well to the mandi. 10 g raises nursery for one acre.
features: Good tolerance to leaf curl virus and early blight in this season
Uniform red fruit, keeps 7 – 8 days after harvest
Nursery raising, transplanting and staking advice included
Also stocked: hybrid chilli, brinjal, okra, cucumber, bottle gourd, cauliflower

specs.label: Nursery
specs.value: 25 – 30 days in pro-trays or raised bed

products.name: Hybrid Mustard Seed, 1 kg bag
products.desc: Bold-seeded, high-oil mustard hybrid for rabi sowing on light and medium soils, suited to one or two irrigations. One kilo sows one acre with margin.
features: Sealed 1 kg pack, lot and expiry printed
Uniform plant height, easy for hand or machine harvest
Sulphur and first-irrigation timing explained at purchase
Season booking taken from September

products.name: DAP 18:46:0, 50 kg bag
products.desc: Di-ammonium phosphate basal fertiliser for wheat, cotton, mustard, potato and vegetables, at the government-notified rate. Urea, MOP (potash), SSP, NPK grades and zinc sulphate also in stock.
features: Company-sealed bag, sold at the printed subsidised price, no over-charging
Sold on POS machine with Aadhaar as per rule; bill given
Per-acre basal dose worked out for your crop and soil-test report
Bulk bags delivered to the village by our loader

specs.label: Dose
specs.value: About 50 kg per acre for wheat as basal, adjust by soil test

specs.label: Also stocked
specs.value: Urea 45 kg ₹267, MOP 50 kg ₹1,650, SSP 50 kg ₹560

products.name: Vermicompost, 50 kg bag
products.desc: Sieved, fully decomposed vermicompost from a local unit for vegetables, orchards and kitchen gardens. Improves soil texture and water holding when used with chemical fertiliser or alone.
features: Dark, odourless, moist and sieved, no plastic or stones
Also in 5 kg bags for kitchen gardens and terrace plants
Bio-fertilisers (Rhizobium, PSB, Azotobacter) and neem cake kept alongside
Rate per tonne for orchard and bulk buyers on request

specs.label: Dose
specs.value: 1 – 2 tonne per acre for vegetables; 5 – 10 kg per fruit tree

specs.label: Use
specs.value: Mix in soil at land preparation or around the root zone

products.desc: Rechargeable 16 litre sprayer with brass and plastic nozzle set, adjustable pressure, 6 – 8 hours of spraying on one charge. Sold with charger, strap, spare nozzle and one-year company warranty.
features: Two-in-one manual plus battery models and 2-stroke power sprayers also kept
Nozzles for insecticide, herbicide flat-fan and fine mist in stock
We service and repair all sprayers; batteries, pumps and switches in stock
Hollow-cone, flood-jet and hooded herbicide nozzles, lances and pipes available

features: Layout drawn from your plot measurements and crop spacing before quoting
ISI-marked laterals and fittings; emitter spacing matched to the crop
Help with the state drip subsidy application and documents
Sprinkler sets, HDPE pipe, rain pipe and mulch film also supplied

specs.label: Covers

specs.label: Includes

services.name: Crop advice & dose guidance
services.desc: Tell us the crop, the land size and the problem, or send a photo of the affected leaf on WhatsApp; we tell you what to use, the dose per pump and per acre, and when to spray.

services.name: Season booking
services.desc: Message your seed, fertiliser and pesticide list for the coming kharif or rabi before sowing; we keep your stock aside at that day's price so you are not stuck when the rains come.

services.name: Delivery to the village
services.desc: Fertiliser bags, seed and drip material delivered to your farm or village on our own loader for orders of 10 bags or ₹5,000 and above; smaller orders clubbed with the next trip to your side.

services.name: Sprayer service & spares
services.desc: Repair of battery, manual and power sprayers at the shop: pumps, batteries, nozzles, switches, pipes and lances in stock; most repairs done the same day while you wait.

services.name: Soil testing & scheme paperwork
services.desc: We show you how to take a soil sample, send it to the government soil-testing lab, explain the report when it comes, and help fill forms for the drip, sprayer and seed subsidy schemes.

services.name: Drip & sprinkler layout and installation
services.desc: Our team measures the plot, draws the layout for your crop spacing, supplies the material and installs the system with a trial run and a short training on fertigation and filter cleaning.

offer.title: Rabi Sowing Booking Offer
offer.text: Book your wheat or mustard seed with DAP before 20 October and get free delivery to the village on 10 bags or more, plus a 500 g pack of Trichoderma seed-treatment powder free — mention the offer on WhatsApp.

reviews.name: Ramesh Patel, cotton farmer
reviews.text: I have been buying my cotton seed and the whole season's dawai from this shop for several years. The packets are always sealed with the proper lot number and the bill is given without asking. Last season I sent a photo of pink bollworm damage on WhatsApp and got the right spray and the dose per pump within ten minutes, which saved me a trip to town.

reviews.name: Sunita Devi, vegetable grower
reviews.text: We grow tomato, chilli and bhindi on two acres for the local mandi. They suggested a hybrid tomato with leaf-curl tolerance, explained the nursery in pro-trays and gave a written spray schedule. Fruit came uniform and firm and fetched a better rate than my neighbour's. The vermicompost is also clean, no plastic or stones.

reviews.name: Harpreet S., wheat and paddy farmer
reviews.text: Booked 25 bags of DAP and wheat seed in September; everything was kept aside and reached the village on their loader two days before sowing. Urea was at the printed price with the POS bill. Only wish was for Sunday evening hours in season, but the WhatsApp replies cover that.

faq.q: Is the seed and fertiliser genuine? How can I check?
faq.a: All stock is company-sealed and bought from the authorised distributor of each company; we never open or repack. Every seed packet carries the lot number, germination percentage and expiry, and every fertiliser bag is sold through the POS machine at the printed price with a bill. Keep the empty packet and the bill till harvest; that is your record.

faq.q: Which wheat or cotton variety should I sow this season?
faq.a: It depends on your soil, water and sowing date. For timely wheat on irrigated land we usually suggest HD-3086 or DBW-187 type varieties; for sowing after 25 November a late-sown type. For cotton on black soil a BG-II hybrid with good boll size. Message your village, soil type, irrigation and planned sowing date on WhatsApp and we suggest two or three options with prices.

faq.q: Do you deliver to the village? What is the minimum?
faq.a: Yes. Orders of 10 bags or ₹5,000 and above are delivered free to villages within about 25 km on our own loader, usually within two days; season bookings are delivered before sowing. Smaller orders are clubbed with the next trip to your side, or you can collect from the shop.

faq.q: How much should I spray and when? Can you tell me from a photo?
faq.a: Yes. Send a clear photo of the affected leaf, stem or fruit in daylight with the crop name and age. We reply with the product, the dose per 15 litre pump and per acre, the spray interval and the pre-harvest gap. The dose is also written on the pack and we repeat it at the counter when you buy.

faq.q: Can I book my season's stock in advance and pay later?
faq.a: You can book seed, fertiliser and pesticide before sowing with a token advance and we keep the stock aside at that day's price. Payment is cash or UPI at pickup or delivery; regular farmers with a running account can ask about season terms at the counter. Fertiliser is sold through the POS machine against Aadhaar as per government rule.

faq.q: Do you keep organic and bio products?
faq.a: Yes: vermicompost, neem cake, neem oil, Trichoderma, Pseudomonas, Beauveria, Rhizobium, PSB and Azotobacter bio-fertilisers, and pheromone traps. Ask which fits your crop; many farmers use these alongside a reduced chemical dose.

agri.address: Shop 3, Krishi Mandi Road, near APMC Gate No. 2, opposite Grain Market
agri.botPersona: Experienced krishi kendra owner who talks like a fellow farmer: short clear lines, asks the crop, land size and village first, then gives the exact product, dose and timing, and never pushes more than the field needs.
agri.botKnowledge: Answers what the shop stocks across seeds (Bt cotton, certified wheat, hybrid mustard, paddy, maize, pulses and hybrid vegetable seed), fertilisers (urea, DAP, MOP, SSP, NPK grades, zinc, water-soluble and micronutrients) at the printed rates, crop protection (insecticides, fungicides, weedicides, bio-pesticides and pheromone traps), organic inputs (vermicompost, neem cake, bio-fertilisers), sprayers and spares, drip, sprinkler, HDPE pipe and mulch film, with the listed prices and pack sizes. Explains per-acre seed rate, basal fertiliser dose and dose per 15 L pump for common crops of the area, and when to sow and spray. Takes a photo of a crop problem and asks the crop and age before suggesting a product. Explains season booking with a token advance, free village delivery on 10 bags or ₹5,000 and above, sprayer repair, soil-test sample collection, drip layout and the subsidy-form help. Gives shop hours, address, UPI and cash payment, and hands over to the owner on WhatsApp for bulk and drip quotations.

army.jobTitle: Subedar Major (Retd.), Indian Army · 28 years of service · Ex-servicemen welfare, Rewari
army.tagline: Fauji discipline, now in service of Rewari
army.about: I joined the Indian Army as a sepoy at nineteen and retired as Subedar Major after twenty-eight years, with postings in Siachen, the Kashmir valley, Rajasthan and the North-East, and two years as an instructor at the regimental centre. Since coming home to Rewari in 2022, my days go to the ex-servicemen of Rewari, Kosli and Bawal — pension and SPARSH problems, ECHS cards, canteen papers, and the families of soldiers who are no longer with us. Every morning at five I run a free physical-training batch at the stadium for boys and girls preparing for Agniveer and Haryana Police, and on request I plan security for societies, schools and functions in the district. The fauj taught me that a job is either done properly or not done at all; that is the only promise on this card.
highlights: Morning PT batch for Agniveer aspirants

If the matter needs the Record Office or the ZSB, I write the letter with you and tell you exactly which window to stand at.

Annual life certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) done at my home or the CSC

offer.text: Bring your discharge book, PPO, Aadhaar and bank passbook to the Sainik Rest House, Circular Road, Rewari. Life certificates, SPARSH logins, ECHS dependent additions and arrears checks are done on the spot; a bank and CSC operator sit with us. Tea and the company of old soldiers are free too.

reviews.name: Hav. Ramesh Yadav (Retd.), Kosli
reviews.text: My pension stopped for three months after the SPARSH migration and the bank kept sending me back to the Record Office. Sahab sat with me for one hour, filed the grievance, called the right person, and the full arrears came in 22 days. He did not take even a cup of tea.

reviews.name: Priyanka, Agniveer selected (2025 batch), Bawal
reviews.text: I could not finish 1.6 km in 8 minutes when I joined the stadium batch. Six months of 5 AM running with his stopwatch and the 9-feet ditch practice, and I cleared the physical in Ambala with the best timing in my group. He checked my documents twice so nothing was rejected.

reviews.name: Sunil Khatri, RWA President, Shanti Vihar
reviews.text: His audit report showed us three places where anybody could jump the wall, and that our night guard was sleeping at 2 AM. Within a month we fixed the lighting, changed the agency and his two-day training made the guards actually check vehicles. Worth every rupee.

faq.q: Are you serving or retired, and from which force?
faq.a: Retired. I served twenty-eight years in the Indian Army and retired as Subedar Major in 2022, with postings in Siachen, J&K, Rajasthan and the North-East and two years as an instructor at the regimental centre. I now live in Sector 4, Rewari. For anything official about my service, the unit and Record Office remain the proper channel; this card is for the work I do for the community now.

faq.q: Can you help with my pension, SPARSH or ECHS problem, and what does it cost?
faq.a: Yes, and for ex-servicemen and their families it is free — always. Message me on WhatsApp with one line about the problem, then come with your discharge book, PPO, Aadhaar and bank passbook. Most matters are sorted in one sitting at my home; the rest need a grievance or a letter to the Record Office or Zila Sainik Board, which I draft with you. The first Sunday of every month there is a free camp at the Sainik Rest House.

faq.q: My son or daughter wants to join the Army or Haryana Police. How do I start?
faq.a: Send them to the stadium at 5 AM any weekday; the first week is free so they can see if they can keep up. I check height, weight, chest and documents on day one and tell you honestly where they stand. Agniveer needs 10th or 12th with the required marks and age 17½ to 21; Haryana Police 18 to 25. The batch fee is ₹1,000 a month and nothing for the children of soldiers.

faq.q: Do you take security assignments? Can you provide guards?
faq.a: I do security audits, guard training and event security planning and supervision; I do not run a guard agency and do not supply guards. For a society or school, the audit is ₹5,000 per visit with a written report; guard training is ₹8,000 for a two-day course at your site; an event plan with supervision on the day is ₹7,500. Message the place, date and size on WhatsApp and I will confirm within a day.

faq.q: Can you speak at our school, college or company function?
faq.a: Gladly, when free. Schools and government colleges pay only the travel; companies and private institutes pay a speaker fee which we agree on WhatsApp. Send the date, place, audience size and age group at least a week ahead. Independence Day, Republic Day and Kargil Vijay Diwas fill up early, so ask well in advance for those.

faq.q: How and when do I reach you?
faq.a: WhatsApp first, any time — write your name, village and the matter in one or two lines. Calls between 8 AM and 8 PM; from 5 to 7 AM I am at the stadium and will call back after. Home visits in Sector 4 by appointment, and I come to your home for elderly veterans and Veer Naris who cannot travel.

army.address: House No. 118, Sector 4, near Sainik Rest House, Circular Road, Rewari, Haryana 123401
army.botPersona: Polite, disciplined, straight-talking assistant in the manner of a retired Subedar Major — respectful 'aap' and 'ji', short clear sentences, Hindi or English as the person writes, warm with veterans and their families, encouraging with young aspirants, and businesslike with societies and event organisers. Never boasts, never promises an outcome with any government office, and never discusses operational or classified matters of the Army.

Knows the document list for pension matters (discharge book, PPO, Aadhaar, bank passbook), the ECHS polyclinic timing (Mon – Fri, 8:00 – 14:00), the Agniveer and Haryana Police age bands, and the free pension camp on the first Sunday of every month, 9 AM to 1 PM at the Sainik Rest House. astro.tagline: Honest kundli, practical remedies, pooja at home
astro.about: We are a family of Vedic astrologers and pandits on Mandir Road, guiding families, students, shop owners and NRIs for everything from a child's naamkaran to a daughter's kundli milan and a new shop's griha pravesh. Every consultation starts with your exact birth time and ends with a written note of what the chart shows and what to do about it, in simple Hindi or English, without fear and without pressure to buy anything. Vastu visits are done at your home, shop or office with a compass and your floor plan, and every pooja, havan and katha is performed at your place on the correct muhurat with the full samagri list sent in advance. Whatever you share with us, your birth details, your questions and your family matters, stays in this room.

products.name: Detailed Kundli Reading (Janam Patri)
products.desc: Your complete birth chart prepared from the exact date, time and place of birth, with lagna, rashi, nakshatra, current mahadasha and antardasha, and a 45-minute sitting on career, education, marriage, health tendencies and finance.
features: Printed kundli (16 pages, Hindi or English) handed to you
Current dasha and the next 2 – 3 years explained in plain words
Sade Sati, Mangal dosha and Kaal Sarp checked and explained honestly
Written remedies note: mantra, daan, fasting day, gemstone only if truly needed

products.name: Kundli Milan for Marriage (Ashtakoot + Mangal Dosha)
products.desc: Both charts matched on all 36 gunas, with Mangal dosha, Nadi dosha and Bhakoot checked properly and not just the guna score. You get a clear yes, no or 'yes with this upaay', along with the reasoning, so the family can decide with confidence.
features: Ashtakoot 36-guna matching with a printed report for both families
Mangal, Nadi and Bhakoot dosha checked with cancellations (not blindly rejected)
Longevity, temperament and financial compatibility of both charts discussed
Second match of the same person checked at half price

features: Chart prepared in advance so no time is wasted on the call

Follow-up on WhatsApp for 30 days after the visit

offer.text: Book Diwali Lakshmi-Ganesh pooja, griha pravesh or any home havan before Dhanteras and get your family's full-year muhurat list (vivah, griha pravesh, vehicle, business, travel) prepared free on WhatsApp.

reviews.name: Sunita D., mother of the bride
reviews.text: We had two rishtas and both charts were matched by Pandit ji in one sitting. He did not just give the guna score; he explained why the first one had a Nadi dosha that was cancelled and the second did not match in Bhakoot. We went ahead with the first and the wedding was fixed on a muhurat he gave. Everything was explained to both families calmly.

reviews.name: Rajesh K., mobile shop owner
reviews.text: My new shop was not picking up for six months. He came with the compass, moved my cash counter from the south-west corner to face north-east, told me to shift the stock room and change the board colour, and gave a fresh opening muhurat. Small changes, no breaking of walls. The written note on WhatsApp was useful to show the carpenter.

reviews.name: Anil & Megha, griha pravesh
reviews.text: Booked the griha pravesh pooja on WhatsApp from Pune while the flat was still being finished. The samagri list came five days before, the two pandits reached at 7 am sharp with the havan kund and finished before the relatives came for lunch. The only thing: Purnima dates get full fast, so book early.

faq.q: What details do I need for a kundli reading?
faq.a: Your date of birth, exact time of birth (from the hospital record or birth certificate if possible) and the place of birth. If the time is not known, tell us; we can do a prashna kundli or birth-time rectification from life events, which takes a little longer.

faq.q: Can I consult on phone or video if I live in another city or abroad?
faq.a: Yes. Send your birth details and question on WhatsApp, we fix a slot between 7:00 and 21:00 IST, prepare your chart in advance and talk on WhatsApp video or Google Meet. The fee is ₹501 for 30 minutes, paid by UPI or bank transfer, and a short written summary is sent after the call.

faq.q: How long does kundli milan take and what do you check?
faq.a: With both birth details, the report is ready the same day. We check all 36 gunas, Mangal dosha with its cancellations, Nadi and Bhakoot dosha, and the strength of both charts for health, temperament and finances. You get a printed report and a 20-minute discussion with the family, and an honest opinion even if it is not what you hoped for.

faq.q: Do you come home for vastu, and can you check a flat before I buy it?
faq.a: Yes, we visit homes, shops, offices and clinics within the city; the home visit is ₹2,100 for up to 3 BHK and ₹3,100 for a commercial place. For a plot or flat you are about to buy, send the floor plan with the north direction marked on WhatsApp for a first opinion, or book a pre-purchase visit at ₹1,100.

faq.q: For a pooja at home, who arranges the samagri and how many pandits come?
faq.a: We send the complete samagri list on WhatsApp 3 – 5 days before so you can buy it locally, or we bring the full kit for a fixed extra charge (₹900 for Satyanarayan, ₹1,800 for griha pravesh, ₹2,500 for Navgrah). One pandit comes for a katha, two for griha pravesh and three for Navgrah shanti; all dakshina is included in the price shown.

faq.q: Will my details and problems stay private? Do you force gemstones or expensive remedies?
faq.a: Everything you share stays between us; we do not discuss one family's chart with another and we do not keep your details on any website. Remedies are mostly mantra, daan and vrat. We suggest a gemstone or rudraksha only where the chart clearly calls for it, we do not sell them, and you are free to buy from any jeweller you trust and bring it to us for pran-pratishtha.

offer.text: Free 25-point check, AC vent cleaning and foam wash with any car service till 10 November; wiper blades and bulbs at 20% off during the camp.

reviews.name: Neha T., working mother
reviews.text: My Swift's AC had been weak for a year and two other garages just topped up gas. These people found a leak at the condenser pipe with the dye, showed it to me on video, fixed it and now it cools properly in city traffic. The estimate came on WhatsApp before they touched anything.

reviews.name: Rakesh, taxi owner
reviews.text: I run three Dzires and cannot afford a car standing idle. They take my cars at 8 in the morning and return them by evening, bill is itemised with every part, and the old parts come back in a bag. The clutch overhaul on one car has done 40,000 km without a complaint.

reviews.name: Dr. Sameer, dentist
reviews.text: After a parking scrape on my Creta they handled the whole insurance claim, including the surveyor visit, and I paid only the depreciation share. The repainted door matches perfectly; I honestly cannot tell which one was done. Took four days as promised.

faq.q: Will servicing outside the showroom void my car's warranty?
faq.a: No. In India the warranty stays valid as long as the service is done on schedule with the recommended oil grade and genuine parts, and we give you a GST bill with the odometer reading and parts list for your record. For cars still under extended warranty or free service, we tell you honestly if the showroom is the better option for that particular visit.

faq.q: How do I know I am not being charged for parts I do not need?
faq.a: Three ways. Before any work, you get a WhatsApp message with the list of jobs, each part's price and labour, and nothing outside that list is done without a fresh approval. Every replaced part is handed back to you in a bag. And the bays are on CCTV, so you can watch live from the waiting area or ask for the link on your phone.

faq.q: Do you give pickup and drop, and is it really free?
faq.a: Yes, free within 8 km of the garage for any service above ₹999; beyond that we charge ₹150 to ₹300 by distance. Message us your location and a time slot; our driver sends you a photo of the odometer and the car when he picks it up and again when he drops it back.

faq.q: How long does a regular service take, and can I wait?
faq.a: A basic car service takes 3 to 4 hours and a bike service 60 to 90 minutes, so you can wait in the AC lounge with Wi-Fi and tea. Comprehensive services, AC work and denting-painting need the car for a day or more; we tell you the exact handover time when you drop it and message you if anything changes.

faq.q: Can you handle my insurance claim for accident repair?
faq.a: Yes, for both cashless and reimbursement claims. Send us photos of the damage and your policy; we raise the claim, arrange the surveyor's inspection at our garage, share the approved estimate with you, and you pay only the deductible and depreciation share when the car is ready. Minor scratches are often cheaper to pay for than to claim, and we tell you that too.

faq.q: Is there a warranty on your work and the parts?
faq.a: Genuine parts carry the manufacturer's warranty, which is on your bill, and batteries and tyres have their brand warranty card registered in your name. On our own workmanship we give 30 days or 1,000 km, whichever is later: if the same complaint comes back in that period, we fix it without labour charge.

For breakdowns it shares the on-call number and asks for the live location.

ayurveda.tagline: Treating the person, not just the symptom
ayurveda.about: We are an Ayurveda and homeopathy clinic on Station Road, with a BAMS vaidya and a BHMS doctor under one roof. People come to us for acidity and digestion, skin and hair troubles, joint and back pain, PCOS, migraine, and the lifestyle complaints that keep coming back. Every patient gets a proper 30-minute sitting — nadi, tongue, history, sleep and daily routine — before a single medicine is written, and the plan always carries a diet list and a dinacharya with it. Medicines are dispensed from our own counter, panchakarma is done by trained therapists in-house, and outstation patients get their follow-ups on WhatsApp.

offer.text: Book any 3 therapy sittings before Diwali and get the Swedana steam session with each one at no extra charge.

reviews.name: Meena D., homemaker
reviews.text: I came for years of acidity and the vaidya spent a full half hour asking about my routine before writing anything. The diet list is stuck on my fridge now. The follow-up on WhatsApp meant I did not have to take leave to visit.

reviews.name: Rajesh, shop owner
reviews.text: Took the 7-day Kati Basti course for my lower back after sitting at the counter all day. The therapist was careful, the oil was warm, and they called me the next week to check how I was sitting and sleeping.

reviews.name: Sunita P., teacher
reviews.text: My son had cold and tonsils every month. The homeopathy doctor took his full case, gave the medicines with the fee, and explained clearly what to expect. Clean clinic and very patient with children.

faq.q: Can I take Ayurvedic or homeopathic medicine along with my allopathic tablets?
faq.a: Usually yes, with a gap of 30–60 minutes, but bring every medicine and report you have to the first visit. Never stop a prescribed tablet for BP, sugar or thyroid on your own — the doctor will tell you if and when anything can change.

faq.q: How long before I see a difference?
faq.a: It depends on the complaint and how long you have had it. Acidity, sleep and acute problems often settle sooner; skin, joints and PCOS take months. The doctor gives you an honest timeline at the first visit, and reviews it every follow-up.

faq.q: What does the first visit cost, and what is included?
faq.a: Ayurveda consultation is ₹400 and homeopathy ₹450 with 15 days of medicine. Ayurvedic medicines are billed separately at the counter, typically ₹500 – ₹1,500 for a month. A follow-up within 15 days is ₹200.

faq.q: Do I need an appointment for panchakarma?
faq.a: Yes. Every therapy starts with a consultation so the vaidya can choose the oil and the sequence for you. Message us on WhatsApp with your complaint and a preferred time; therapy slots run from 9:30 am to 1 pm and 5 pm to 7:30 pm.

faq.q: Is the diet strict? I eat outside a lot.
faq.a: The list is practical — what to prefer, what to limit, and the meal timings that matter most. Many patients eat out a few times a week and still follow it. Tell the doctor your routine honestly so the plan fits your life.

faq.q: I live in another city. Can I consult online?
faq.a: The first consultation is better in person, especially for nadi pariksha. After that, follow-ups can be on WhatsApp or video call, and medicines can be couriered against UPI payment. Homeopathy cases can also be started on video.

ayurveda.botKnowledge: Consultation fees for Ayurveda and homeopathy and what each includes; therapy list with prices, duration and course options (Abhyanga, Shirodhara, Swedana, Kati Basti, 7-day Panchakarma, diet plan); the Diwali Detox Week offer; clinic hours, therapy slot timings and Sunday appointments; address, landmark and parking; how to book on WhatsApp and what to bring to the first visit (old reports, current medicines); online follow-up and courier of medicines for outstation patients; payment by cash and UPI. The bot never diagnoses, never suggests a medicine or dose, and never promises a result — for any health question it asks the patient to book a consultation.

builder.about: We are a civil construction company building independent houses, duplexes, shop-cum-residences and small commercial buildings for families and business owners across the city and nearby towns. You can hand us the whole job as a turnkey contract with branded material written into the agreement, or bring your own material and take only our masons, bar-benders and site engineer on a labour contract. Every project starts with a measured plan, a stage-wise estimate and a written schedule, and our engineer stands on the site daily and sends you progress photos on WhatsApp so you know what was done before you release the next payment. Families choose us because the house we hand over is the house that was drawn, the money we quoted is the money we take, and the homes we built earlier are open for you to walk through before you sign.

reviews.name: Sunil & Pooja M., home owners

reviews.name: Dr. Anjali R., clinic owner
reviews.text: They built our ground-floor clinic with two shops above it. The ramp, the wider doors for a wheelchair and the separate meter room were all planned in the drawing stage, so there were no last-minute breakages. reviews.name: Farooq, first-floor extension
reviews.text: Adding a floor on my father's old house while the whole family stayed downstairs was my biggest worry. They checked the columns first, covered the staircase with sheets and finished in five months. Dust in the first two weeks was more than expected, but the finished floor is solid and the new tenant moved in the week after handover.

faq.q: Do you charge per square foot or a lump sum, and what is the current rate?
faq.a: For new houses we quote per built-up square foot: ₹1,799 for the standard turnkey package and ₹2,249 for premium, measured as per the approved plan. Renovation and commercial work is quoted as a lump sum or item-rate BOQ after a site visit. Send your plot size, number of floors and rooms on WhatsApp and you get a stage-wise estimate within 3 working days.

faq.q: What exactly is included in the turnkey package, and which brands?
faq.a: Everything from excavation to the final coat of paint: structure, brickwork, plaster, flooring, doors, windows, electrical, plumbing, sanitary ware, painting, overhead tank, sump and compound wall up to the plinth. The brand of cement, steel, tiles, wire, pipes and fittings is written in the agreement with a model or range, and any upgrade you choose is billed at the difference only. Borewell, lift, modular kitchen and furniture are not included unless added.

faq.q: How is payment done?
faq.a: In stages, written in the agreement, usually 10% at signing, 15% at plinth, 20% at each slab, 15% at brickwork and plaster, 15% at flooring and the balance 5% at handover. Each stage is released by you after seeing the completed work and the photos. Payment is by bank transfer, cheque or UPI with a receipt and running account statement; we never ask for cash advances.

faq.q: How long will my house take?
faq.a: A 1,200 sq ft ground-plus-one house takes about 7 to 9 months from foundation to keys; a larger premium duplex 9 to 11 months. The month-wise schedule is part of the agreement and allows for the monsoon and the curing time of each slab. A delay caused by us is covered by a per-day deduction clause; delays from material changes by the owner or approval holds are recorded and added to the date.

faq.q: Can I see the houses you have built and talk to the owners?
faq.a: Yes. We share photos and short videos of completed and ongoing sites on WhatsApp, and we take you to at least two finished homes and one site under construction, usually on a Sunday morning, so you can see the plaster, the tiles and the finishing with your own eyes and ask the owners how the work went.

faq.q: Will you get the plan approved, and what about Vastu?
faq.a: We prepare the drawings and file them with the local authority or panchayat; the government fees are paid by you at actuals and we handle the follow-up. If you want a Vastu-compliant layout we plan the entrance, kitchen, puja room and master bedroom accordingly, and we are happy to incorporate changes suggested by your own Vastu consultant before the drawings are finalised.

faq.q: Do you take small jobs like one bathroom or a boundary wall?
faq.a: Yes. A single bathroom, a kitchen redo, a compound wall, a car porch or a terrace waterproofing job are all welcome and quoted as a lump sum after a visit. Send a few photos and the rough size on WhatsApp and we tell you the same day whether we can take it up and when.

faq.q: What documents do I need for my income tax return?
faq.a: For salaried: PAN, Aadhaar, Form 16, bank statements for the year, and proofs of investments, rent, home-loan interest or medical insurance. For a shop or profession: the same plus sales and purchase summary, bank statements of all accounts and last year's return. Message us the word ITR and a checklist for your case comes back on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do I need GST for my small shop?
faq.a: Registration becomes compulsory when turnover crosses ₹40 lakh for goods (₹20 lakh for services), or earlier if you sell on Amazon, Flipkart or to other states. Below that it is optional, but many shops register so that wholesalers and companies can buy from them. Tell us your turnover and what you sell and we will say yes or no in one message.

faq.q: Can I send everything on WhatsApp, or do I have to come to the office?
faq.a: Photos or PDFs on WhatsApp work for returns, GST, TDS and most registrations. You need to visit only for signing audit reports, physical verification for a company or when a bank wants originals. Outstation clients from the tehsils work with us fully on WhatsApp.

faq.q: I received a notice from the income tax or GST department. What should I do?
faq.a: Do not reply on your own and do not ignore it; most notices have a 15- or 30-day window. Send us the PDF on WhatsApp — the first reading and explanation is free. We tell you what it is asking, what it will cost to reply, and file the reply with the right documents.

faq.q: How are your fees decided?
faq.a: The fees on this page are fixed for standard cases. For audit, company work and notices, the fee depends on turnover and the number of entries, and we tell you the amount in writing before starting. There are no surprise charges at the end; government fees and late fees, if any, are at actuals and shown separately.

faq.q: What is the difference between the old and the new tax regime, and which should I pick?
faq.a: The new regime has lower slab rates but almost no deductions; the old regime lets you claim 80C, HRA, home-loan interest and more. Which one saves more depends on your salary structure and investments. We compute both for every return and file whichever gives the lower tax — you see both figures before we file.

offer.title: Diwali Safai Offer
offer.text: Book a full home deep cleaning before Diwali and get the kitchen cockroach gel treatment free — one call, a ready home for the puja.

reviews.name: Meenakshi R., homemaker
reviews.text: We had cockroaches coming out of the kitchen drain every night for months. The gel treatment took under an hour, had no smell, and I did not have to shift a single dabba from the cabinets. It has been three months and nothing. They even called after a week to check.

reviews.name: Imran, restaurant owner
reviews.text: We took the yearly AMC for our kitchen and dining area. The team comes on the fixed date every month, early morning before we open, and leaves a filled service register that we show during inspections. Rodent problem in the store room was sorted in the first two visits.

reviews.name: Dr. Pooja S., clinic
reviews.text: Booked the deep cleaning after our clinic renovation. Four people came with a floor scrubber and a wet vacuum, and all the cement dust from the windows, grills and false ceiling corners was gone by evening. Only small thing — they reached 30 minutes late, but called ahead to tell us.

faq.q: Is the treatment safe for small children, elderly people and pets?
faq.a: Yes. For cockroach and ant control we use odourless gel bait that goes inside cabinets and cracks, so there is no spray in the open. Where a spray is needed we tell you in advance: cover food and water, keep children and pets out of that room for 3 to 4 hours, and wipe kitchen slabs once before use. Birds and aquariums are moved or covered before we start.

faq.q: Do I need to leave the house during the service?
faq.a: For gel treatment, rodent control and all cleaning work, no. For bed bug and general spray treatment we ask you to keep the treated rooms closed for 3 to 4 hours, so most families step out for lunch or do it on a Sunday morning. Termite treatment is noisy because of drilling, but you can stay in the house.

faq.q: How long does the effect last, and what if the pests come back?
faq.a: Cockroach gel treatment usually holds for 3 to 6 months; bed bugs are finished with the two-visit programme; termite treatment carries a 2-year written warranty. Every treatment comes with a free revisit within its warranty period — just send a message with a photo and we schedule it. For restaurants and offices we recommend the AMC so the visits are regular.

faq.q: Do you do termite treatment for a new house under construction?
faq.a: Yes. Pre-construction anti-termite treatment is done in three stages — foundation pits, plinth filling, and along the outer walls before flooring — at ₹9 per sq ft. Message us the stage your site is at and the plinth area, and we send a quote and visit the site the same week.

faq.q: What exactly is included in home deep cleaning?
faq.a: Every room top to bottom: ceiling fans, lights, switchboards, windows and grills, window channels, doors, wardrobes outside, kitchen cabinets inside and out, chimney exterior, gas hob, sink, bathroom tiles, taps, WC and mirrors, balcony and floor scrubbing. Not included: inside of fridge and oven, utensils, washing clothes, and terrace — these can be added at a small extra charge if you tell us while booking.

faq.q: Which areas do you cover and how do I pay?
faq.a: We cover the whole city and villages up to about 25 km; for farther sites a small travel charge is told upfront. Pay by cash, UPI or card after the work is done and you have checked it. AMC customers get a GST invoice and can pay yearly or quarterly.

club.tagline: Service done together, accounted for openly
club.about: We are a chartered service club of doctors, traders, teachers, engineers and young professionals from our city, meeting on the second and fourth Tuesday evening and working the rest of the month on projects people here can actually see: blood donation camps with the district blood bank, eye and cataract camps in the highway-side villages, school kits and desks for government primary schools, tree plantation every monsoon and relief when a flood or fire hits a basti. Every rupee a sponsor gives is tied to a named project, receipted the same week and shown in the audited accounts read out at our annual general meeting. New members come as guests first, sit through two or three meetings and are inducted only after they have seen how we work. Whether you want to join, sponsor a camp in your firm's name or need a camp in your colony, one WhatsApp message starts it.

products.name: Blood Donation Camp (full sponsorship)
products.desc: A one-day voluntary blood donation camp at your firm, colony, college or temple grounds, run with the district blood bank's doctors and technicians. Sponsor it in your family's or firm's name; we bring the donors, the banner and the certificates, and you cut the ribbon.
features: Blood bank team, beds, screening and collection kits arranged by the club
Target of 50 to 80 units; donors mobilised from our members, colleges and your staff
Refreshments, donor certificates and a thank-you memento in the sponsor's name
Banner, stage and photo report shared the same evening on WhatsApp and social media

specs.label: Lead time
specs.value: 3 weeks (blood bank date to be booked)

products.name: Free Eye Check-up & Cataract Screening Camp
products.desc: A rural eye camp with an ophthalmologist and optometrist team: vision testing, free reading glasses on the spot, and cataract patients listed and taken by bus to the partner eye hospital for surgery under the government scheme.
features: Eye doctor, two optometrists and screening equipment for the day
150 pairs of free reading glasses distributed on the spot
Cataract patients listed, transported and followed up till their surgery
Village panchayat and ASHA workers involved for announcements and crowd

specs.label: Venue
specs.value: Village school or panchayat bhawan, arranged by us

specs.label: Sponsor gets
specs.value: Name on banner, glasses pouches and the camp report

products.name: School Kit Drive — One Government School
products.desc: Adopt a government primary school for the new session. Each child gets a school bag, six notebooks, a geometry box, pencils, a water bottle and a pair of shoes, handed over at an assembly in your presence. Typical school: 80 to 150 children.
features: Kit list fixed with the headmaster so nothing is duplicated or wasted
Items bought in bulk from local wholesalers; bills shared with the sponsor
Distribution assembly with the sponsor, the school staff and club members
Follow-up visit in the next quarter to check attendance and needs

products.name: Tree Plantation Drive (100 saplings, with guards)
products.desc: One hundred native saplings — neem, peepal, jamun, amaltas, gulmohar — planted along a road, in a school compound or on a crematorium or temple boundary, each with an iron tree guard and a two-year watering arrangement with the local caretaker, because a sapling without a guard is gone in a month.
features: Site chosen with the municipality or panchayat so the trees are not cut later
Iron tree guards and a named plate for the sponsor on the row
Watering and replacement of dead saplings for two monsoons
Plantation morning with your family or staff; photos and a survival report at six months

specs.label: Includes
specs.value: Guards, pits, manure, two years' care

products.name: Student Scholarship — One Year
products.desc: Sponsor one deserving student from a government school or college for a year: fees, books and a bus pass, paid directly to the institution and the bookshop, never in cash. Students are selected by the club's education committee on marks, family income and a home visit.
features: Selection on class 10 or 12 marks, income proof and a committee home visit
Fees paid to the school or college, books and uniform bought with the student
Sponsor receives the student's mark sheet at the end of every term
Mentoring by a club member in the student's field of study

specs.label: Covers
specs.value: Fees, books, uniform and bus pass

products.name: Winter Blanket & Sweater Distribution
products.desc: Thick mink blankets and woollen sweaters for families in the labour bastis, rickshaw pullers at the station and patients' attendants sleeping outside the district hospital, distributed at night in the second half of December when it actually matters.
features: Blankets bought at wholesale rate in bulk; sample shown to sponsors before purchase
Night distribution rounds with members, so blankets reach people who sleep in the open
Children's sweaters and caps for the anganwadi centres of the same bastis
Sponsor can join the round; a photo report follows each night

products.name: Health & Diabetes Screening Camp
products.desc: A half-day general health camp at a colony park, factory or market: blood sugar, blood pressure, BMI, haemoglobin and a doctor's consultation, with free basic medicines and a referral card for anyone who needs a specialist. Ideal for a trader association, a housing society or a factory's workers.
features: Two doctors, nurses and pathology technicians from partner hospitals
Sugar, BP, haemoglobin and BMI tests with a printed report card for each person
Basic medicines for the day and referral slips to partner hospitals at concessional rates
Dental or gynaecology desk can be added for ₹8,000 each

Dues cover the club's fixed costs and the international and district fees; projects are funded separately. You attend two or three meetings as a guest first, a member proposes your name, and you are inducted at a regular meeting.
features: Two dinner meetings a month with a speaker, project planning and fellowship
A role in a project committee from the first month — health, education, environment or youth
Pin, membership card and access to the global network when you travel
Family invited to the installation night, picnic, Diwali and the New Year fellowship

services.desc: Career talks in schools, inter-school quiz and sports day, and a youth club for students and young professionals under 30.

services.desc: Attend a meeting as a guest: a doctor, officer or entrepreneur speaks, projects are planned and dinner follows.

services.name: Member business directory
services.desc: Every member's profession and firm is listed, so a member's referral comes with a face you have met.

offer.title: World Blood Donor Day: co-sponsor a camp for ₹10,000
offer.text: For camps booked for June, two or three sponsors can share one blood donation camp at ₹10,000 each — all names on the banner, all receipts separate, and each sponsor gets their donor certificates to hand out.

reviews.name: Dr. Meena K., member since 2019
reviews.text: I joined for the fellowship and stayed for the eye camps. Last winter we screened over three hundred villagers in one Sunday and the cataract patients were operated within the month at the partner hospital. The accounts are read out line by line at the AGM, which is why my family trusts the club with its Diwali donation.

reviews.name: Sanjay A., owner, steel fabrication unit
reviews.text: We sponsored the blood donation camp at our factory gate in our late father's name. The club handled the blood bank, beds, banner and even the snacks; our workers donated 64 units. The receipt and photo report came the same evening. Only suggestion is to start the camp half an hour earlier in summer.

reviews.name: Pooja R., headmistress, govt primary school
reviews.text: The club adopted our school for kits and desks. They asked us for the list first, bought exactly what the children needed, and came back in October to check who was still attending. Two of our girls are now on their scholarship. This is the kind of help a school actually needs.

faq.q: How do I become a member, and who can join?
faq.a: Any adult of good standing — a professional, business owner, officer or homemaker — can apply. Message us and we invite you as a guest to the next two or three meetings so you can see the club at work. A member then proposes your name, the board approves it, and you are inducted at a regular meeting. The whole process takes four to six weeks.

faq.q: What does membership cost each year?
faq.a: Annual dues are ₹6,000, which cover the international and district fees, the meeting venue and administration, plus a one-time admission fee of ₹2,500. Meeting dinners are paid per head or settled quarterly. Project donations are separate and entirely voluntary — nobody is pressed to give beyond their dues.

faq.q: Can the club organise a camp in our colony, factory or village?
faq.a: Yes. Send the place, the number of people expected and the kind of camp — blood, eye, general health or dental. The projects committee meets twice a month, confirms a date and the costs, and tells you whether the club is funding it, a sponsor is, or you would like to. Most camps are scheduled within six to eight weeks.

faq.q: How does my firm sponsor a project, and what do we get?
faq.a: Choose a project from this page or tell us a budget and we will suggest one. You pay directly to the club's project account by cheque or bank transfer, get a receipt within the week, and your name or logo goes on the banner, the stage and the photo report. Larger sponsors can present the kits or certificates themselves. Donations to the club's charitable trust qualify under section 80G where applicable; ask us for the current certificate.

faq.q: When and where are the meetings, and can I come once as a guest?
faq.a: We meet on the second and fourth Tuesday of every month at 19:30 at our regular venue, which is on the Contact page. Guests are welcome, but please message a day before so we can add you to the dinner count and seat you with a member who will introduce you.

faq.q: How do I know the money is actually used for the project?
faq.a: Each sponsored project has its own line in the accounts, with purchase bills shared with the sponsor on request. The accounts are audited every year by a chartered accountant and read out at the annual general meeting, which sponsors are invited to attend. Camp reports with photos and counts go out on the day of the event.

club.address: Club Office, 1st Floor, Community Hall, Civil Lines, near District Hospital Gate No. 2
club.botPersona: A warm, well-informed club secretary's assistant who answers simply about joining, meetings, sponsoring a project and requesting a camp, and takes a name and number for the committee to call back.
club.botKnowledge: The bot answers about every project and programme on this page with its cost, reach, lead time and what the sponsor receives (blood donation, eye and cataract camps, school kits, tree plantation, scholarships, blanket distribution, health screening), the membership process and dues, meeting day, time and venue, how to attend as a guest, how a firm or family sponsors and gets a receipt, the 80G position of the trust, the current offer, office hours and the address. It explains that camps are scheduled by the projects committee and gives the typical waiting time, collects the enquirer's name, number, area and the kind of camp or project for a committee member to call back, and never promises a specific camp date, a membership decision or a tax benefit without the board or the treasurer confirming it.

coaching.tagline: Small batches. Daily doubts cleared. Real results.
coaching.about: We run a coaching centre for Class 6 to 12 students of CBSE and the State Board, with separate batches for JEE/NEET foundation, government job exams and spoken English. Our classrooms are on the second floor of a complex on Station Road, five minutes from the bus stand, with morning batches before school and evening batches after. Parents choose us because the batches are small, every student writes a test each week, and the marks come to the parent's WhatsApp the same evening along with the teacher's remark. Our teachers are postgraduates who have taught the same syllabus for years, so they know exactly where students get stuck in each chapter and plan the class around it.

products.name: Class 6 to 8: All Subjects
products.desc: Maths, Science, English and Social Science covered chapter by chapter alongside the school, so homework and school tests stop being a struggle at home. Reading and handwriting practice every Friday.
features: Four subjects, six days a week
School homework checked in class
Chapter test every Saturday
Separate CBSE and State Board batches

products.name: Class 9 and 10: Maths & Science
products.desc: The two subjects where board marks are won or lost. Every theorem and numerical is done on the board first, then in the workbook, then in a timed test. Syllabus finishes by November so three full months go to revision and sample papers.
features: Separate Maths and Science teachers
NCERT line-by-line plus exemplar problems
Weekly test with board-style marking
Monthly parent call from the class teacher

Last 10 years' questions, topic-wise
One-page formula and diagram sheets per chapter
Doubt counter open till 9 pm during the course

Pre-boards with answer sheets returned

Economics graphs drawn and redrawn till they stick
Chapter-wise BST case studies

offer.text: Join any batch before 30 April and the ₹500 registration fee is waived, with the full-year notes set given free on day one.

reviews.name: Sunita D., mother of a Class 10 student
reviews.text: My son was scoring 55 to 60 in Maths at school. After the Saturday tests started and I began getting the report on WhatsApp every week, I could finally see which chapters were weak. He scored 86 in his pre-boards. The teacher called me personally twice in the year without my asking.

reviews.name: Arjun K., SSC aspirant
reviews.text: I work a morning shift so the 6 pm government exam batch suited me. The 20-minute timed set at the end of every class is what fixed my speed in Quant. The daily current affairs sheet on WhatsApp saved me from buying three magazines.

reviews.name: Meenakshi R., Class 12 Commerce
reviews.text: I had never seen Accounts before Class 11 and the first month was scary. Sir made us do journal entries with actual bill copies till it became normal. The 7 am batch is early, but it means my evenings are free for self-study.

faq.q: Which boards and classes do you teach?
faq.a: Class 6 to 12 for CBSE and the State Board, in separate batches so the syllabus order matches the school. For Class 11 and 12 we run Science (PCM/PCB) and Commerce; Arts students can join for English and Economics.

faq.q: Is there a demo class, and is it really free?
faq.a: Yes. Message us the class and subject and we will tell you the next slot. The student sits through one full class, meets the teacher and sees the notes. No payment and no registration until you decide to join.

faq.q: How many students are in one batch?
faq.a: Up to 15 in Class 6 to 10, up to 20 in Class 11 and 12, and 12 in Spoken English. When a batch fills, we open a second one at a different time rather than adding benches.

faq.q: Can fees be paid monthly or in instalments?
faq.a: School-class fees are monthly, payable by the 10th by cash, UPI or bank transfer. For the three-month courses (government exams, spoken English, crash course) you can pay in two instalments; ask at the counter.

faq.q: What if my child misses a class?
faq.a: Every class is recorded. The student gets the recording link the same evening, and can bring doubts from that chapter to the 5 to 6 pm doubt counter the next day. Notes for the missed class are kept at the desk.

faq.q: How do parents know the child is actually improving?
faq.a: The Saturday test marks and the teacher's one-line remark go to the parent's WhatsApp every week. Once a month the class teacher calls each parent, and you can walk in to meet the teacher any day between 5 and 6 pm.

Most of our students are the first in their family to go to college, and many come from villages and small towns around the district, so we keep fees sensible, help with every scholarship form and run a hostel and bus routes so distance is never the reason a student drops out. Classes are taken by regular, full-time faculty, attendance and internal marks are shared with parents every month, and the placement cell starts working with students from the second year, not the last semester. faq.q: Is the college recognised, and are the degrees valid for government jobs?
faq.a: Yes. The college is affiliated to the state university and all our degree courses are approved by it. The degree is issued by the university, so it is valid for government jobs, higher studies and competitive exams. You can see the affiliation letter at the office or ask us on WhatsApp.

faq.q: What is the eligibility and how is admission done?
faq.a: For UG courses you need a 12th pass certificate; B.Sc needs Science with 45% and BBA needs 50% in any stream, with relaxation as per government rules for reserved categories. Admission is on the basis of 12th marks through a merit list, and for B.A. and B.Com it is usually on first-come basis till seats last. Fill the form at the office or online, and we call you for counselling within two working days.

faq.q: Which documents do I need to bring?
faq.a: 10th and 12th marksheets and certificates, transfer certificate (TC) and character certificate from your school, Aadhaar card, caste or income certificate if applying for a scholarship, migration certificate if you are from another board, and six passport-size photos. Bring originals and two photocopies of each.

faq.q: What is the fee structure and can I pay in instalments?
faq.a: Annual fees are listed under each course on this page and include tuition, library and lab charges; university exam fees are extra and paid directly to the university. The fee can be paid in two instalments, July and January, without any extra charge. Students eligible for a state scholarship pay only the balance.

faq.q: Is there a hostel and bus facility?
faq.a: Yes. Separate girls' and boys' hostels are inside the campus with a vegetarian mess, and college buses run on six routes covering the nearby towns and villages. Message us your area or village name and we will confirm the route, pick-up time and the yearly bus fee.

faq.q: Do you help with placements after the course?
faq.a: The placement cell starts working with students from the second year with resume sessions, aptitude practice and mock interviews, and arranges campus drives by local companies, banks, retail chains and software firms. We help with every opportunity we can get, but the final result depends on the student's attendance, marks and preparation, so we never promise a job.

Our students are Class 10 and 12 pass-outs, college students, shop owners who want to do their own GST billing, housewives returning to work and job seekers preparing for typing tests. Every course is taught on a machine, not on a blackboard: you sit at your own computer from the first day, the trainer walks the rows, and the lab stays open for free practice between batches. faq.q: I have never used a computer. Which course should I start with?
faq.a: The Basic Computer Course. It starts from switching on the machine and holding the mouse, moves to typing, MS Office, internet and UPI, and the notes are in Hindi with screenshots. Most of our Tally and DCA students began exactly here.

faq.q: What are the batch timings and can I change my batch later?
faq.a: Batches run every hour from 7 am to 8 pm, Monday to Saturday, with Sunday batches for working people. If your college or shop timing changes, tell us a day before and we shift you to another batch of the same course at no cost.

faq.q: Will I get a certificate and is it valid for jobs?
faq.a: Yes. Every course ends with a practical test and you get a certificate with a unique number that anyone can verify on our website. DCA comes with a marksheet. Many offices and shops accept it; for government posts, check the exact requirement of that notification, as each one is different.

faq.q: Can I pay the fee in instalments?
faq.a: Yes, on every course longer than two months. Tally is ₹2,000 × 3, DCA is ₹1,500 × 6 and graphic design is ₹2,000 × 4. The first instalment is paid at admission; the rest are due at the start of each month. We give a printed receipt every time.

faq.q: Do I need my own laptop?
faq.a: No. You get your own computer for the full class, and the lab is free for practice between batches. If you do have a laptop at home, we help you install the same software so you can practise at night.

faq.q: Do you help with jobs after the course?
faq.a: We help you make a resume, run mock interviews and share vacancies that shops, CA offices and companies send us. We do not promise a job; the course gives you the skill that employers ask for, and the interview is yours to clear.

faq.q: How do I track my parcel?
faq.a: The tracking number is printed on your receipt and we also send it on WhatsApp the same evening. Enter it on the courier company's site or app, or simply message us the number and we check and reply with the current status.

faq.q: Can I send mithai, pickles or home-made food?
faq.a: Yes, dry sweets, namkeen, dry fruits and sealed pickle jars go within India. Liquids and oily items must be in leak-proof containers; we double-pack them. Fresh or perishable food is not accepted. Food parcels abroad are not allowed by most countries, so please ask first.

faq.q: What do I need for an Aadhaar update?
faq.a: Bring your original Aadhaar and the proof for the change: electricity bill, bank passbook or rent agreement for address; 10th marksheet or passport for name and date of birth. A mobile-number update needs no document, only your fingerprint. The whole thing takes about 15 minutes.

faq.q: How many days does delivery take?
faq.a: Within India: metro cities 2–3 working days, other towns and district places 3–5, remote and hill areas up to 7. Abroad: Gulf 3–4 days, UK, USA, Canada and Australia 5–7. Sundays and courier holidays are not counted.

faq.q: Will you pick up the parcel from my home or shop?
faq.a: Yes, within town. Message the address and a rough weight on WhatsApp and we collect it the same day. Pickup is ₹30 within 3 km and free when there are 5 or more parcels. Shops sending daily get a fixed evening pickup.

faq.q: Is money transfer safe and how do I pay you?
faq.a: The transfer goes by IMPS to the receiver's bank account and both of you get an SMS from the bank within minutes; you get a printed receipt with the reference number. For all services we accept cash and UPI at the counter, and shops with a monthly account pay by bank transfer.
