reviews.name: Meenakshi R., homemaker
reviews.text: We shifted from packet milk to their buffalo milk eight months ago. The malai layer after boiling is thick enough to collect for ghee, and the delivery boy is at our gate at 6:45 every single day, even in the rains. The pause-by-WhatsApp thing actually works — our Diwali trip days were deducted in the bill.

reviews.name: Imran, sweet shop owner
reviews.text: I take 40 kg of danedar khoa and 60 litres of milk daily for my shop. The khoa is consistent — my kalakand sets the same way every day, which was my biggest problem with the earlier supplier. On Holi and Diwali they handled double quantity without a single day missed.

reviews.name: Dr. Anand S., regular customer
reviews.text: I went to the dairy first to see the shed before subscribing — clean, cattle well kept, cans sanitised in front of me. We take the desi cow milk for my parents and the paneer every Sunday. Only suggestion: cow milk runs out, so book early.

faq.q: How do I know the milk is pure and not mixed with water or powder?
faq.a: Come to the dairy any morning and we test our milk on the lactometer and the Gerber fat test in front of you — buffalo milk reads 6.5% fat or more, desi cow milk 4 to 4.5%. The herd is ours, milked on site, and the cans are sealed within an hour. Subscribers can ask the delivery boy for a fat check at any time.

faq.q: Which areas do you deliver to and at what time?
faq.a: We run morning routes (6 to 7:30 am) and evening routes (5:30 to 7 pm) across the city, about 8 km around the dairy. Send your location on WhatsApp and we confirm your route and the time your lane is covered. Outside the route we can still supply bulk orders of 20 litres and above.

faq.q: How does the monthly account work? Can I pause when I travel?
faq.a: You pay nothing in advance. We note your daily quantity, and on the 1st of every month you get a bill on WhatsApp for the days delivered — pay by UPI or cash to the delivery boy. To pause or change quantity, message us by 8 pm the night before and that day is not charged.

faq.q: What is the difference between your buffalo milk and desi cow milk?
faq.a: Buffalo milk (₹72) is thicker, with 6.5 to 7% fat — better for chai, kheer, paneer and anyone who likes heavy malai. Desi cow milk (₹85) from our Gir and Sahiwal cows is lighter at 4 to 4.5% fat and naturally a little sweet; many families prefer it for children and elders. Cow milk is limited, so it is booked a day in advance.

faq.q: Do you supply to sweet shops, hotels and events?
faq.a: Yes. Halwais and hotels take daily milk, khoa, paneer and dahi on a fixed quantity with a monthly GST bill; tell us your daily need and we fix a rate. For weddings and functions we deliver 50 to 1,000 litres, dahi in matkas and paneer blocks to the venue; book 7 days ahead with a 25% advance.

faq.q: Is the ghee really made from cream, and how long does it keep?
faq.a: Yes — malai is collected over the week, cultured into dahi, churned to makkhan and slow-cooked every Sunday; each jar carries the batch date. Buffalo ghee is ₹1,299 and desi cow ghee ₹2,100 per kg. Kept closed at room temperature it stays good for 12 months; it will turn granular in winter, which is normal.

dance.jobTitle: Dance, Music & Art Classes for Kids and Adults
dance.tagline: Learn properly, perform proudly, every age welcome
dance.about: We run a dance, music and art academy on the first floor above the main market, with two mirrored dance studios, a sound-proofed music room and a bright art corner for children. Our kathak, Bollywood, hip-hop, vocal, tabla, guitar and keyboard batches are taught by trained teachers who follow a proper syllabus, so a child who joins at six and an aunty who joins at forty-five both learn step by step, not just a dance for one function. Students get real stage time twice a year at our annual show and the Ganesh Utsav programme, and parents can sit in the waiting area and watch every class through the glass. Fees are told clearly before you join, there is a trial class, and we never push a student into a batch that is too advanced for them.

faq.q: From what age can my child join?
faq.a: Dance and art batches start at 4 years, instruments and vocal at 7 to 8 years because small hands and voices need to be a little stronger. Message us the child's age and we will suggest the right batch.

faq.q: Is there a trial class, and does it cost anything?
faq.a: Yes, one trial class is free in any batch. Message us the course and we will give you the next batch time; just come in comfortable clothes.

faq.q: What are the batch timings?
faq.a: Weekday batches run 16:00 to 20:30 after school and office hours; weekend batches run Saturday and Sunday mornings. The full timetable is on the Courses page, and we message the current one on WhatsApp.

faq.q: How is the fee paid, and what if we miss classes?
faq.a: Fees are paid monthly by UPI or cash before the 10th. If a student misses a class for illness, they can attend another batch of the same course that month; we do not deduct fees for one or two missed classes.

faq.q: Do you prepare for exams or give certificates?
faq.a: Yes. Kathak and vocal students can appear for Prayag Sangeet Samiti or Prachin Kala Kendra exams, drawing students for the Elementary and Intermediate Grade exams, and guitar or keyboard students for Trinity grades. We fill the forms and arrange practice; exam fees are paid separately to the board.

faq.q: Can adults and complete beginners join?
faq.a: Of course. We have separate adult batches in kathak, Bollywood, vocal and guitar, and nearly every adult who joins has never learnt before. You start from the basics and nobody is made to feel awkward.

reviews.name: Meenakshi R., teacher
reviews.text: I came in scared of a root canal and it was done in two sittings with barely any discomfort. Doctor showed me the X-ray before and after and explained why the cap was needed. The cost quoted on day one is exactly what I paid.

reviews.name: Arjun K., father of two
reviews.text: My 5-year-old sat through her first filling without crying, which I did not think was possible. They let her hold the mirror and count the teeth first. The clinic is spotless and they open sealed instruments in front of you.

reviews.name: Harbhajan S., retired
reviews.text: Got my full dentures made here. Four fittings and they adjusted it twice more for free when it rubbed on one side. I can eat roti and even chana properly now. Only wish they had parking closer.

faq.q: Will the treatment hurt?
faq.a: A numbing gel is applied before the injection, and the injection makes the area numb for the whole procedure. You feel pressure and vibration, not pain. If anything bothers you, raise your left hand and we stop.

faq.q: How much does a root canal cost, and does the cap cost extra?
faq.a: A root canal is ₹4,500 for a front tooth and ₹5,500 for a molar. The cap is separate: metal ₹2,500, porcelain-fused-to-metal ₹3,500, zirconia ₹6,500. The full cost is written down after the X-ray, before we start.

faq.q: Do you take dental insurance or offer EMI?
faq.a: Most Indian health insurance does not cover routine dental work, but we give a printed receipt and treatment summary for any claim. For braces and implants we accept monthly instalments at the clinic; pay per sitting for everything else.

faq.q: I have sudden tooth pain. Can I come today?
faq.a: Yes. Send a message on WhatsApp with your name and the problem, and we fit you in between appointments during clinic hours. Come without eating on the painful side and bring any medicine you have already taken.

faq.q: At what age should a child first see the dentist?
faq.a: By age 3, or as soon as you see a black spot. The first visit is just a ride in the chair, a count of the teeth and a fluoride application, so the child is comfortable before any treatment is ever needed.

faq.q: How do you sterilise instruments?
faq.a: Every hand instrument is cleaned, sealed in a pouch and autoclaved after each patient; the sealed pouch is opened in front of you. Needles, gloves, suction tips and bibs are single-use, and the chair is wiped down between patients.

faq.q: Which brands and products do you distribute, and which area do you cover?

faq.q: Is there a visiting charge?

faq.q: How soon can you come?

event.about: We are a decoration, DJ and event management team working out of a godown-cum-office on Bypass Road, doing weddings, sangeets, haldi and mehndi functions, birthdays, baby showers, griha pravesh pujas and office events across the city and in the villages and farmhouses around it. The flowers, backdrops, sound system, lights, tent and furniture are all our own, so one phone call covers the entrance gate to the last chair, and nothing gets held up waiting for a third vendor. You send us reference photos from Instagram or Pinterest, we send a drawing of the stage and a written quote with every item and its price, and the setup is finished and checked by our supervisor before the baraat leaves. From a 25-guest birthday in a living room to a 1,200-guest reception at a marriage garden, the same team plans it, builds it and winds it up after the last song.

The stage was finished at 4 pm for a 7 pm baraat, and the supervisor was still standing there at midnight when the pheras ended. Only the dinner-table flowers were a bit smaller than the photo.

reviews.name: Sandeep K., father of the bride
reviews.text: Took the full wedding decor with the DJ for the sangeet. One quote, one advance, one number to call, and the sangeet stage was turned into the reception stage overnight without us even knowing. The dholki songs the ladies wanted were already on the DJ's list after one WhatsApp message.

reviews.name: Preeti S., mother of a 1-year-old
reviews.text: Booked the jungle-theme balloon decor for my son's first birthday at home with two days' notice. Two boys came at 2 pm, finished by 4, and the arch with his name in wooden letters was the background of every photo that evening. The magician they arranged kept 20 kids quiet for 40 minutes.

faq.q: Can I book only the DJ, or only the stage decoration, without the full package?
faq.a: Yes. Every item on this page can be booked on its own: a DJ for a sangeet, a mandap for a temple wedding, a balloon setup for a birthday, or just 200 chairs and a tent for a jagran. Message us the function, date, venue and the items you need and we send the rate for exactly that, with no pressure to add more.

faq.q: Can you do a particular theme I saw on Instagram or at a relative's wedding?
faq.a: Send us the reference photos or reel on WhatsApp. Within a day we send a drawing of how it will look on your stage size, the flowers and materials we will use and the price for fresh versus artificial flowers. Pastel, royal maroon-gold, all-white, Rajasthani, South Indian temple style and jungle or Bollywood themes are regular for us; anything new we build a sample corner of first.

faq.q: How much advance do you take, and what if the date changes?
faq.a: ₹15,000 blocks a Stage & Mandap date, ₹40,000 blocks the Full Wedding, ₹5,000 blocks a DJ night and ₹2,000 a birthday setup. The balance is paid in two parts: half when the setup is finished and checked by you, half after the function. One date change is free if you tell us 30 days ahead and we are free on the new date; otherwise the advance is adjusted against any booking in the next 12 months.

faq.q: Do you work outside the city, at farmhouses and village weddings?
faq.a: Yes. Within 40 km the transport is included in the price. Beyond that we add one truck of transport and the team's stay at actuals, usually ₹4,000 to ₹12,000 depending on the distance and the size of the setup. Village weddings in the family compound, with our own tent, lighting and generator, are common for us; send the location pin and we quote the same day.

faq.q: What about permissions and timing for DJ sound and lights?
faq.a: The local rules on timing (usually sound till 10 pm outdoors) and loudness apply, and we keep within them because a police visit spoils the night for everyone. For indoor halls we play till the hall's closing time. For an outdoor venue we tell you what the rules are at booking and, if the venue needs it, we help with the written permission application. A generator is always included, so the show does not depend on the venue's power.

faq.q: When does the setup start and who is there on the day?
faq.a: For a wedding we start the day before or at 6 am on the day, and the stage and mandap are finished at least 3 hours before guests arrive. A supervisor with a phone stays at the venue through the function for any last-minute change (a fan for the pandit, more chairs, a mic for the toast) and the team returns the same night or the next morning to wind up, so the venue is handed back clean.

faq.q: What documents do I need to bring for a loan?
faq.a: For any loan: PAN, Aadhaar, a photo and 6-12 months of bank statements. Salaried customers add 3 salary slips and Form 16; self-employed add 2 years of ITR with computation and GST returns. For home or property loans, the full chain of property papers. Send us photos on WhatsApp first and we tell you exactly what is missing.

faq.q: My CIBIL score is below 700. Will I get a loan?
faq.a: Some NBFCs do lend between 650 and 700 at a slightly higher rate, and a secured loan against property or gold is easier. Below 650 we usually suggest our credit score improvement plan first, so you apply once and get approved rather than getting rejected and lowering the score further. We will tell you honestly, not file a hopeless application.

faq.q: Do you give the loan yourselves? What is your fee?
faq.a: No. We are advisors and channel partners; the loan comes from a bank or NBFC and the approval and interest rate are theirs. For most home and vehicle loans the lender pays us, so you pay nothing extra. Where a fee applies, such as some business loans or a complex property file, we tell you the amount in writing before we start.

faq.q: How many days does it take to get the money?
faq.a: Personal and vehicle loans usually 3-7 working days after documents are complete. Business loans 7-15 days. Home loans and loan against property 2-4 weeks because of valuation and legal check. We share the file status on WhatsApp at every stage so you are never guessing.

faq.q: I am self-employed with cash income. Which loans can I get?
faq.a: Business loans, home loans and loan against property on the strength of your ITR, GST returns and bank statements. Some lenders also do assessed-income programmes for shopkeepers with low declared income but good bank transactions. Share your last 12 months of statements and we will match you with the right programme.

faq.q: Can I start a small SIP, and can I stop it any time?
faq.a: Yes, a SIP can start at ₹500 a month, and you can pause, stop or increase it any time without penalty; only a few funds have a small exit load if you withdraw within a year. Returns depend on the market and nobody can promise a figure, which is why we match the fund to how long you can stay invested.

faq.q: What is your exchange policy if the size does not fit?
faq.a: Unworn pairs with the box and bill can be exchanged within 7 days for another size or style of the same value. Pairs worn outside, washed or without the box are not exchanged, which is why we make you walk on the shop floor before billing.

faq.q: Do you keep large, small or wide sizes?

faq.q: Are the branded shoes genuine?
faq.a: Yes. Branded stock comes from authorised distributors, carries the original box, tag and warranty card, and is sold with a GST bill. Our own ethnic and Kolhapuri range is sourced directly from the makers in Jaipur and Kolhapur.

faq.q: Do you have school shoes all year, and can a school order in bulk?
faq.a: Yes, black and white school shoes in every size are stocked all year, not only in April. For 30+ pairs we give bulk pricing, come to the school with a size kit, and deliver within 10 days with one bill.

faq.q: Can I see and reserve shoes on WhatsApp?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us the type, size, colour and budget and we send photos and a short video of what is in stock. Reserve with a ₹300 UPI advance; it is adjusted in the bill or refunded if the pair does not suit you at trial.

faq.q: Do you repair or resole shoes?
faq.a: Yes. Our cobbler handles stitching, loose soles, heel tips and straps while you wait where possible; resoling of leather formals and mojaris takes 3 to 4 days. Shoes bought here get free polishing any time.

reviews.text: Got the sheesham king bed with storage. They measured our bedroom first because the door was narrow, and brought the headboard separately so it went in without scratching the wall. Polish is even and the hydraulic box opens with one hand.

reviews.name: Rajesh, PG owner
reviews.text: Ordered 12 bunk beds and 12 study tables for my PG. Price was fixed on paper the first day, delivery came on the date they said, and their boys assembled everything in two days. Already ordered chairs for the second floor.

reviews.text: We sent a Pinterest photo of an L-shape sofa and they made it in our fabric, 6 inches shorter to fit our hall. Cushions were a little soft at first but they changed the foam density without any fuss.

faq.q: Can you make furniture in my size and design?
faq.a: Yes. Most pieces are made in our own workshop, so size, wood, finish and fabric are up to you. Send a photo and the wall or room measurement on WhatsApp and we send a price and date within a day.

faq.q: Which wood do you use and what is the difference?
faq.a: Sheesham and teak are solid woods that last for decades and can be re-polished; teak costs more. BWR plywood with laminate suits wardrobes and kitchens because it is lighter and does not warp. Engineered wood is the budget option for TV units and study tables. We show samples of all three in the showroom.

faq.q: Do you deliver and fit at home? What are the charges?
faq.a: Yes, our own team delivers and assembles the piece in your room. Delivery is free inside city limits on orders above ₹15,000; for nearby towns we charge actual transport, which we tell you before billing.

faq.q: How long does a made-to-order piece take?
faq.a: Usually 15 to 30 days depending on design and polish. The date is written on your order slip. Ready pieces from the showroom are delivered within 2 to 3 days.

faq.q: Do you repair or re-polish old furniture?
faq.a: Yes. Send photos of the sofa, bed or almirah on WhatsApp and we quote for repair, polish or new fabric. For bigger jobs we pick up and drop back; small polish work is done at your home.

faq.q: Is EMI available and how do I pay?
faq.a: Card EMI is available on purchases above ₹20,000 through most major bank cards. Otherwise 40% advance at order and balance on delivery, by cash, UPI, card or bank transfer. A proper GST bill is given with every purchase.

govt.tagline: Right desk, right papers, first visit
govt.about: We serve the citizens of this tehsil from the Revenue Department's office on Collectorate Road — farmers, students, pensioners, contractors and families who need a certificate, a land record, a mutation or simply a hearing. Our job is to make the process clear before you leave home: which form, which documents, which counter, and how long the notified timeline is. Jan Sunwai is held every Tuesday without appointment, field visits go out on fixed days, and the WhatsApp number on this page replies with the document checklist so that one visit is enough. Public service is the post; this page only makes it easier to reach.

products.desc: Needed for scholarships, EWS, fee concessions and most welfare schemes. Apply online on the state e-District portal or at the tehsil counter; the Lekhpal verifies and the certificate comes with a QR code that any office can check.

specs.label: Notified timeline

specs.label: Validity

reviews.name: Mohd. Irfan, PWD contractor
reviews.text: Needed a haisiyat certificate for a tender with a tight deadline. The checklist on this page saved me two trips; the Lekhpal's valuation was done within the week. It still took the full notified time, so apply early, but there was no running around and no extra payment anywhere.

faq.q: Which documents do I need for an income, caste or domicile certificate?
faq.a: For all three: Aadhaar, one address proof (ration card, electricity bill or bank passbook), one passport photo and the self-declaration form from the counter or the portal. Income also needs a declaration of the family income; caste needs a relative's caste certificate or a school record showing caste; domicile needs a school or birth certificate. Message the certificate name on WhatsApp and the exact list for your case comes back.

faq.q: How long does a certificate take, and can it be made faster?
faq.a: The notified timelines are 15 working days for income and domicile and 20 for caste, counted from a complete application. Most files are done sooner, but nobody at the office can promise a date or take money to speed one up — if anyone asks, report it at Jan Sunwai. Incomplete papers are the usual reason for delay, so use the checklist.

faq.q: Do I have to pay at a CSC or private kiosk?
faq.a: The portal fee is ₹30 for most certificates and ₹15 per khata for a khatauni copy, and that is all. A CSC may add a small typing charge, but ₹100 – 200 'for fast work' is not an official fee. Applications at the tehsil counter are free; bring your own photocopies.

faq.q: How do I check the status of my application or case?
faq.a: Certificates: enter the application number on the e-District portal, or send it on WhatsApp. Revenue court cases: the next hearing date is on the court notice board and the revenue court portal. Complaints: quote the Jan Sunwai register number. We reply with the desk the file is on and the next step.

faq.q: Can I meet you without an appointment?
faq.a: Yes — Jan Sunwai on Tuesday from 11:00 to 13:00 is open to everyone without a pass. On other working days, counters handle routine work and the office meets citizens between 15:00 and 16:00 if the officer is not in court or on field duty; a message in the morning confirms whether that day is possible.

faq.q: Is this the official website of the department?
faq.a: No. This is the personal contact page of the officer for public convenience. Applications, fees and certificates are handled only on the state portals and at the tehsil office; nothing is applied for or paid through this page. Use it for information, checklists, camp dates and to reach the office.

Knows office hours, counter numbers, Jan Sunwai on Tuesday 11:00 – 13:00, Thursday village camp schedule, demarcation days, how to check status on the e-District, Bhulekh and grievance portals, and which matters belong to other departments (ration cards to Supply office, pension payments to Social Welfare, registry to the Sub-Registrar). gym.tagline: A trainer on the floor, every batch
gym.about: We are a 3,500 sq ft gym and yoga studio on the second floor above Galaxy Complex, opposite the District Stadium, open from 5:30 in the morning for office-goers and shopkeepers who train before work. Members come to us for weight training, cardio, a 6 am yoga batch, evening Zumba and one-to-one personal training, and most of them walked in as complete beginners. There is always a certified trainer on the floor, not just at the reception — the first week is spent teaching the right form, and every plan is reviewed with a body-composition check each month. We keep a separate ladies' batch with a lady trainer, wipe and sanitise every machine between batches, and take a free trial before you pay for anything.

offer.title: New Year Fitness Offer
offer.text: Join a quarterly or annual plan before 15 January and get a free diet consultation plus two personal-training sessions to set your routine.

reviews.name: Amit K., bank employee
reviews.text: I joined the 5:30 am batch because I have to be at the branch by 9:30. The trainer wrote me a simple four-day routine in the first week and stood with me on every lift till my squat form was right. Three months in, my back pain from sitting at the desk is much better.

reviews.name: Priya S., homemaker
reviews.text: The ladies' batch at 11 is a relief — a lady trainer, nobody staring, and the plan started really light after my second delivery. The diet chart was all home food, no fancy stuff I cannot buy here. Machines are wiped down before our batch starts.

reviews.name: Ravi, shop owner
reviews.text: Took the 6:30 pm yoga batch for my knees and sleep. The instructor shows an easier version of every asana and never pushes. Only thing — the Zumba music from next door is loud on some evenings, so I go on functional days.

faq.q: What are the batch timings?
faq.a: The gym floor is open 5:30 am to 10:30 am and 4:30 pm to 9:30 pm, Monday to Saturday, with the ladies' batch from 11 am to 1 pm. Yoga runs at 6:00 am and 6:30 pm, Zumba and functional classes at 7:00 pm. Sunday is 7 am to 11 am, gym floor only.

faq.q: I have never been to a gym — will I be lost?
faq.a: No. Almost everyone here started as a beginner. In your first week the trainer walks you through every machine, writes a simple three or four-day routine and stands with you on each exercise until the form is right. You will not be handed a sheet and left alone.

faq.q: Can I take a trial before paying?
faq.a: Yes — one full session with a trainer in any batch is free. Message us on WhatsApp with a preferred time, come in shoes and comfortable clothes, and bring a water bottle. Decide on a plan only after that.

faq.q: Is there a separate batch for women?
faq.a: Yes. The 11 am to 1 pm batch is women-only with a lady trainer, a separate changing room and lockers. Women are welcome in all other batches too, and a lady trainer is on the floor in the evening batch as well.

faq.q: Do you give a diet plan?
faq.a: Basic diet guidance is included with every membership. A written chart with a body-composition reading is ₹499, and comes free with personal training and annual plans. The chart is built around home food. If you have diabetes, thyroid or any medical condition, please check the chart with your doctor.

faq.q: Can I pause my membership if I travel or fall ill?
faq.a: Yes. Monthly plans can be frozen for up to 7 days, quarterly for 15 and annual for 45 days in the year. Tell us on WhatsApp before you leave, not after you come back, and the days are added to your validity.

faq.q: How do I pay, and is there a joining fee?
faq.a: Cash, UPI or card at the desk, or UPI on WhatsApp. There is no joining fee. Quarterly and annual plans can be paid in two instalments; we share a receipt on WhatsApp for every payment.

Material reaches the building by afternoon and the monthly bill is clean, item by item. The boys even hold my regular shades in stock before season.

reviews.name: Meena K., flat owner
reviews.text: We were redoing two bathrooms and had no idea what to buy. They took the plumber's list, corrected two wrong pipe sizes, showed taps and commodes together so everything matched, and delivered the cartons to the third floor. Nothing came back for exchange.

reviews.name: Imran S., electrician
reviews.text: Good stock of FR wire, MCBs and modular switches, and they always have the odd items like 4 sq mm green wire that other shops run out of. Prices are fair with a GST bill. Only wish they opened a little earlier on busy days.

faq.q: Can you match a paint shade from a photo or an old wall?
faq.a: Yes. Bring a swatch, a chipped piece of plaster or even a cushion cover, or send a clear photo in daylight on WhatsApp. We match it on the tinting machine, give you a free 100 ml test pot to try on your wall, and save the code so the same shade can be repeated years later.

faq.q: How much paint do I need for my house?
faq.a: As a rough rule, a 2 BHK of about 900 sq ft carpet area takes 20 L of interior emulsion for two coats plus 10 L of primer on fresh walls. Send us the room sizes or a plan on WhatsApp and we send back an exact quantity list with buckets, primer, putty and rollers.

faq.q: Do you deliver to construction sites, and what is the charge?
faq.a: Yes, on our own tempo. Delivery is free within 5 km for orders above ₹5,000; smaller orders and farther sites carry ₹150 – ₹400, told to you before dispatch. Orders confirmed before 2 pm reach the same day; unloading is at ground level unless you arrange labour.

faq.q: Do you give contractor or bulk rates?
faq.a: Yes. Regular painters, plumbers, electricians and contractors get bulk rates on paint, pipes, wire and cement and can open a running account with a monthly bill. Visit once with your GST or Aadhaar details and we set it up the same day.

faq.q: Can I return or exchange unused material after the job?
faq.a: Sealed, unused items in original packing can be exchanged within 15 days with the bill; this covers full paint buckets of ready shades, pipes in full lengths, fittings and electrical items. Machine-tinted paint, cut pipes, cut wire and opened cement bags cannot be taken back.

faq.q: Do you keep a specific brand, and are the products genuine?
faq.a: We stock the common national brands in paint, sanitary ware, pipes, wire and tools, and we are an authorised dealer for several. Message the product and brand name; if it is not on the shelf we usually arrange it from the distributor in 2 – 4 days. Every item comes with a GST bill and the brand warranty card where applicable.

faq.q: How do I pay?
faq.a: Cash, UPI and all cards at the counter; UPI link or bank transfer for WhatsApp and site orders. Big bathroom or full-house orders can be paid in two parts, an advance at booking and the balance on delivery.

hospital.tagline: Emergency day and night, care you can trust
hospital.about: We are a 50-bed multi-speciality hospital on Civil Lines Road, serving families from the city and the surrounding villages. Our OPD runs six days a week across general medicine, surgery, maternity, children, orthopaedics and ENT, with a 24-hour emergency, ICU, operation theatre, pathology lab, X-ray and ultrasound, and a pharmacy under one roof. Every patient gets a written estimate before admission or surgery, an itemised bill at discharge, and a desk that helps with cashless insurance, TPA and Ayushman Bharat. We keep the family informed at every step, because a hospital stay is easier when nobody is left guessing.

reviews.name: Sunita D., new mother

reviews.name: Rajesh K., son of a patient

reviews.name: Mohd. Imran, shop owner
reviews.text: Got my knee replaced here after walking with pain for two years. The physiotherapist made me walk on day two itself. The private room was clean and my wife could stay with me. Only wish the canteen opened earlier in the morning.

faq.q: Is the emergency open at night and on Sundays?
faq.a: Yes. The emergency, ICU, ambulance and pharmacy run 24 hours, every day including Sundays and holidays. A doctor is always on duty; call the emergency number and come straight in, we will keep the bed ready.

faq.q: Which doctors sit in the OPD and when?
faq.a: General physician and paediatrician sit every day 9:00 to 14:00 and 17:00 to 19:00. Gynaecologist, surgeon, orthopaedic and ENT have fixed OPD days. Message your problem on WhatsApp and we will tell you the doctor, day and time and book a token so you wait less.

faq.q: Do you accept cashless insurance and Ayushman Bharat?
faq.a: Yes. We are empanelled with most insurance TPAs and with Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY). Send a photo of your policy or scheme card on WhatsApp before admission and the insurance desk will check eligibility and start the pre-approval.

faq.q: What does a package include, and what is extra?
faq.a: Each package lists the stay, doctor fees, OT charges and ward medicines it covers. Blood, implants not named in the package, ICU care if a complication arises, and extra days are charged separately at rate-card prices. You get the estimate in writing before admission.

faq.q: What should we bring for admission?
faq.a: Aadhaar or any photo ID of the patient, old reports and prescriptions, current medicines, insurance or Ayushman card, and one attendant. For a delivery, also bring the antenatal file and the baby's clothes. Bedding and food for the attendant are available at the canteen.

housing.about: We are the elected residents' welfare association of a 180-flat society of four wings, running the gate, housekeeping, water, lifts, gardens and community hall on behalf of every owner and tenant who lives here. reviews.name: Sunita M., resident, B-304
reviews.text: Our kitchen drain line was choking for weeks and nothing happened till the new committee started the ticket system. I messaged on a Monday, got a ticket number in ten minutes, the plumber came on Tuesday and the office actually asked me if it was fixed before closing it. Receipts for maintenance now reach my phone the same day I pay.

reviews.name: Rakesh K., tenant, A-wing
reviews.text: Tenants are usually treated like outsiders, but here the office registered us, got the police verification form done and added us to the gate app on the first day. Zomato and Amazon deliveries ring my phone for approval instead of wandering around the building. Hall booking for my son's birthday was simple too.

reviews.name: Col. (Retd) Verma, senior resident
reviews.text: What I value is that the accounts are put up every month and the AGM is held on time with audited figures. The garden is maintained, the lift AMC is actually followed, and the guards know every family by name. The Independence Day flag hoisting and breakfast is something the whole society looks forward to.

faq.q: How do I pay the monthly maintenance and get a receipt?
faq.a: Pay by UPI or bank transfer to the society account printed on your bill, or by cheque at the office. Message the screenshot with your flat number on WhatsApp and the receipt comes back the same day. Dues are payable by the 10th; a ₹100 late fee applies after the 20th.

faq.q: How do I raise a complaint and how long does it take?
faq.a: Send your flat number and the issue (with a photo if possible) on WhatsApp or write it in the office register. You get a ticket number; routine issues like lights, cleaning or seepage in common areas are usually attended within two working days, and lift or water breakdowns the same day. The ticket is closed only after you confirm.

faq.q: I am selling or renting my flat. How do I get the NOC?
faq.a: Submit the application form, your ID, the sale or rent papers and clear any pending dues. The secretary issues the NOC within seven working days; the sale NOC is ₹1,000 and the rent or loan NOC ₹500. For a sale, the share certificate transfer is done at the same time.

faq.q: Can tenants join the WhatsApp group and use the gym and hall?
faq.a: Yes. Once the owner's consent form, tenant ID and police verification receipt are on file, the tenant is added to the gate app and the residents' group and can use the gym, hall and guest rooms at resident rates. Voting at the AGM is for owners only.

faq.q: What are the water supply timings and what happens when the municipal supply fails?
faq.a: Pumps run 06:00 – 08:00 and 18:00 – 20:00 for all wings. If the municipal supply is short, the office arranges tankers the same day and puts the update on the group; residents are asked to avoid car washing on such days.

faq.q: When is the AGM held, and how is the committee elected?
faq.a: The AGM is held every year before 30 September, with 21 days' notice on WhatsApp and the notice board, where the audited accounts and next year's budget are passed. The nine-member committee is elected by owners every two years at the AGM; any owner with dues cleared can stand.

insurance.jobTitle: LIC Agent & Insurance Advisor — Life, Health & Motor
insurance.tagline: The right cover for your family, no pressure
insurance.about: We are an LIC agency and insurance advisory office near the Civil Lines bus stand, serving families, shopkeepers, teachers and salaried people from the city and the nearby tehsils. People come to us for term and savings plans from LIC, health insurance for the whole family, and car and two-wheeler policies — but mostly they stay because of what happens after the policy: a reminder before every premium date, a nominee or address change done the same day, and someone who sits with them at the hospital counter or the LIC branch when a claim has to be filed. We write every plan on one sheet — premium, term, what the family gets and when — so you decide at home, in your own time, and nobody is sold a policy they do not understand.

products.name: Term Life Cover — ₹1 Crore
products.desc: Pure protection for the family: if something happens to the earning member during the term, the nominee receives the full sum assured. The lowest premium per rupee of cover that exists; every family with a loan or children should start here.
features: ₹50 lakh to ₹2 crore cover, 20 to 40 year term
Monthly or yearly premium, fixed for the whole term
Option to pay the claim as a monthly income to the family
Medical test arranged at home where the insurer requires it

products.name: Savings + Life Cover Plan (Endowment)
products.desc: The classic LIC way to save: a fixed premium for 15 to 25 years, a lump sum at maturity with the bonus declared by the insurer each year, and life cover for the family throughout. Suited to people who want a disciplined, safe saving they will not touch.
features: Maturity amount plus yearly bonus as declared by LIC
Life cover for the family during the whole term
Loan against the policy after three years
Premium qualifies under Section 80C; maturity as per Section 10(10D)

products.name: Money-Back Plan
products.desc: A savings plan that pays part of the sum assured back to you every five years while the policy runs, with the balance and the bonus at maturity. Good for people who like money coming back at intervals — school admission, a daughter's wedding, a shop expansion.
features: Survival payouts every 5 years during the term
Full sum assured to the family on death, even after payouts
20 or 25 year term with shorter premium-paying option
Payout dates planned around your family's milestones

products.name: Child Education & Marriage Plan
products.desc: Started in the child's name when they are small, so that a fixed sum is ready at 18, 20 and 22 for college and later for marriage. If the parent paying the premium is no more, future premiums are waived and the plan continues for the child.
features: Payouts timed to 18, 20, 22 and 25 years of age
Premium waiver rider if the paying parent passes away
Can be started from 90 days of age
Yearly bonus added by the insurer as declared

products.name: Pension / Retirement Plan
products.desc: Build a pension while you earn, or convert a lump sum — gratuity, PF, a property sale — into a monthly income for life. We show you the actual monthly pension figure for your amount and age before you decide anything.
features: Deferred plan while working, or immediate pension from a lump sum
Pension monthly, quarterly or yearly, for life
Joint-life option so the spouse keeps receiving it
Purchase price returned to the nominee under the return-of-capital option

offer.title: Free family cover check-up this Diwali
offer.text: Bring every policy your family holds — LIC, health, vehicle, any company — before 15 November and we hand you one sheet with your total cover, the premium calendar and what is missing. No fee, no obligation to buy.

reviews.name: Sunita D., school teacher
reviews.text: My husband's policy had lapsed for two years after he lost the receipt book. Sir got it revived with one medical form and sat with me at the branch himself. Now the reminder comes on WhatsApp ten days before every premium.

reviews.name: Mohammed F., garment shop owner
reviews.text: My father was admitted in the night and I had no idea about cashless. One call at 11 pm and he had the TPA desk sorted by morning; we paid nothing except the non-medical items. He had told me on day one to keep the health card in my wallet, and that is what saved us.

reviews.name: Ankit R., bank employee
reviews.text: I went in for a ₹25 lakh term plan and came out with ₹1 crore for only ₹400 more a month because he showed the numbers on paper and did not push any savings plan. Honest comparison. Only thing — the office closes at seven, so I had to come on a Saturday.

faq.q: Which policy should I take first — term, savings or health?
faq.a: For most families: a term plan of 10 to 15 times your yearly income first, then a health floater for the whole family, and only after that a savings or child plan with whatever is left each month. Tell us your age, the family members and roughly what you can set aside, and we send you two or three options on one sheet with the premium for each.

faq.q: How much will my premium actually be?
faq.a: The premiums on this page are samples for a given age and cover. Your exact figure depends on age, smoking, health, the term and the sum assured, and we quote it from the insurer's own calculator before you pay a rupee. Life insurance premiums are the same whether you buy through us or anywhere else; the difference is who helps you at renewal and claim.

faq.q: What documents do I need to start a policy?
faq.a: PAN, Aadhaar, a passport photo and a bank cancelled cheque for every policy. For term and larger life covers, add income proof (salary slips, ITR or Form 16) and a medical test, which we arrange at your home or a nearby centre. For vehicle insurance, only the RC and the previous policy. We fill the forms with you; you just sign.

faq.q: What happens at claim time? Will you help?
faq.a: Yes, that is the main reason to have an agent. Message us first — for a hospital, before admission if possible, so cashless is arranged at the TPA desk; for a death claim, we come home, prepare the claimant statement, death certificate, bond and bank details, submit them at the branch and follow up till the amount is credited to the nominee. We stay with the family through the whole process.

faq.q: My LIC policy lapsed two years ago. Can it be revived?
faq.a: Usually yes. LIC allows revival within five years of the first unpaid premium by paying the arrears with interest and, depending on the gap and the sum assured, a health declaration or a medical. Send the policy number on WhatsApp and we tell you the exact revival amount and what is needed; if revival does not make sense, we say so.

faq.q: Can you service a policy I bought online or from another agent?
faq.a: For LIC policies, yes — premium payment, reminders, nominee and address changes, loans and claims can be done through our office whoever sold the policy. For health and vehicle policies from other insurers, we renew them with you and help at claim time. Share the policy copy on WhatsApp and we confirm what we can do.

insurance.botKnowledge: The bot answers about every plan on this page (term cover, endowment and money-back savings plans, child plan, pension, health floater, car and two-wheeler insurance), the sample premiums and what changes them, the document list for each, office hours and address, the Diwali offer, how premium reminders and payments work, and the after-sales services — claim help, revival of lapsed policies, nominee and address change, loan and surrender. It explains in plain words the difference between term and savings plans, what a family floater and cashless mean, what a no-claim bonus is, and the 80C and 80D tax sections. It never quotes a final premium, promises a return, bonus or claim outcome, or gives medical or legal advice; for anything that depends on the person's age, health or policy papers it asks them to send the details on WhatsApp so the advisor can check with the insurer's calculator.

faq.q: How long will it take to go live?

faq.q: How can I pay, and is EMI available?

faq.q: Do you deliver at home, and is there a minimum order?

faq.q: Can I order my whole month's ration in one go?
faq.a: Yes, that is what most of our regular customers do. Send your list once on WhatsApp or hand it over at the counter; we save it, pack it on your chosen date every month and send a reminder two days before so you can add or remove items.

faq.q: Do you sell loose (khula) items or only packets?

faq.q: Do you keep a specific brand I use?
faq.a: We stock the brands people in the area ask for most. If yours is not on the shelf, message us the name and pack size; we usually get it from the distributor within 2 – 3 days and keep it stocked once you order it regularly.

faq.q: How can I pay?
faq.a: Cash, UPI and cards at the counter. For WhatsApp orders and deliveries we send a UPI payment link or you pay the delivery boy by UPI or cash. Regular customers can run a monthly khata settled on the 1st.

offer.title: Free 15-minute first call for new clients
offer.text: Send a short message about your matter on WhatsApp and we call you back the same working day for a free 15-minute first discussion, so you know whether it is worth a full consultation before you spend anything.

reviews.name: Sunil K., hardware shop owner
reviews.text: A dealer bounced a cheque of ₹1.8 lakh and kept avoiding my calls. The legal notice went out within two days and he settled the full amount before the court date. The fee was told to me in writing before anything started.

reviews.text: Came for my parents' will. Sir sat with them for almost an hour, explained every line in Hindi and arranged the registration date himself. My mother felt heard, which matters more than anything.

reviews.name: Rakesh, tenant
reviews.text: Landlord refused to return the deposit after I vacated. One notice from this chamber and the money came in three weeks. The WhatsApp updates after every step meant I never had to chase anyone.

faq.q: What should I bring to the first consultation?
faq.a: Every paper connected to the matter: the notice or FIR copy, agreements, receipts, bank statements, photos, WhatsApp chats and your ID. If you send photos of the papers on WhatsApp a day earlier, we read them before you come and the 30 minutes are used properly.

faq.q: How are your fees decided and when do I pay?
faq.a: Drafting work such as notices, agreements and wills has a fixed price listed on this page. For court matters the fee is stage-wise — filing, evidence, arguments — and written down at the first meeting so there are no surprises. Court fees, stamp duty and process fees are paid at actuals with receipts. Cash, UPI and bank transfer are all accepted.

faq.q: Can you tell me whether I will win my case?
faq.a: No advocate can promise a result, and you should be careful of anyone who does. What we do is read your papers and tell you honestly where the matter is strong, where it is weak, and whether settling is a better option than fighting.

faq.q: Which courts do you appear in?
faq.a: The District & Sessions Court, family court, consumer forum, labour court and the Sub-Registrar office here in the city, and the High Court for appeals, bail and writ matters. For a matter in another district we can either travel or connect you with a trusted colleague there.

faq.q: Will I get updates on my hearing dates?
faq.a: Yes. After every hearing you receive a WhatsApp message the same evening saying what happened and what the next date is. You do not need to attend every date; we tell you clearly which ones need your presence.

faq.q: Is my matter kept confidential?
faq.a: Completely. What you share with us is protected by advocate-client privilege. Your papers are kept in a locked file, your case is never discussed with anyone outside the chamber, and family matters are heard in a separate cabin, not the open office.

faq.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faq.a: For ready-stock items like almirahs, racks and lockers a single piece is sold at retail price; dealer price starts at 5 almirahs or 10 racks. Made-to-order items and pallets usually start at 20 pieces, and job work has no fixed minimum — we quote per job.

faq.q: Can you make it to my size or design?
faq.a: Yes. Send a drawing (DWG or PDF), a sample piece or a clear photo with the main sizes on WhatsApp. We confirm the gauge, finish and price within a working day, make one sample if the quantity is large, and start the lot only after you approve it.

faq.q: Which sheet gauge and finish do you use?
faq.a: Almirahs and lockers are 22-gauge CRCA with 18–24 gauge back and base as stated on each product; racks use 14-gauge angle and 20-gauge shelves. Every piece goes through seven-tank degreasing and phosphating and is powder coated at 60–80 micron. The gauge is written on your quote, so you can check it with a gauge plate on delivery.

faq.q: How long does an order take?
faq.a: Stocked sizes and colours go out in 2–4 working days. Made-to-order lots take about 10–20 working days depending on quantity — 100 school desks take roughly 15. The exact lead time is written on the quote and we message you when the lot is packed.

faq.q: Do you deliver outside the city and who pays freight?
faq.a: Yes, we load on part-load or full-truck transport anywhere in India, and by courier for small job-work parts. Freight is to pay at your end unless agreed otherwise; for project orders we can quote delivered-to-site. Every consignment has a GST invoice, e-way bill and transport LR.

faq.q: What if a piece arrives damaged or a lock does not work?

faq.q: Do you deliver medicines at home?
faq.a: Yes, within 3 km of the store, usually within 2 hours and the same day for orders received before 8 pm. Send the prescription photo and your address on WhatsApp; delivery is free on bills above ₹500 and ₹30 below that.

faq.q: Do I need a prescription for every medicine?
faq.a: For scheduled medicines (antibiotics, BP, sugar, sleep and pain medicines etc.) a doctor's prescription is required by law and we keep a copy. Over-the-counter items like ORS, antacids, band-aids, vitamins and baby products can be bought without one.

faq.q: Can you give a cheaper generic instead of the brand written?
faq.a: We can show you the generic with the same salt and strength and its price, but we change the brand only after you confirm with your doctor. For long-term medicines many doctors are happy to write the generic if you ask.

faq.q: What if a medicine is not in stock?
faq.a: We order it from the distributor the same day; most medicines arrive by the next morning and rare ones in 2 – 3 days. We message you the moment it reaches and can deliver it directly.

faq.q: Can I return or exchange medicines?
faq.a: Unopened, uncut strips and sealed items can be exchanged within 7 days with the bill. Insulin and other fridge medicines, cut strips, syrups and opened devices cannot be taken back, as per drug rules.

faq.q: Can you suggest a medicine for my fever or cough?
faq.a: We can only dispense what a doctor has prescribed and guide you on over-the-counter basics like ORS or a thermometer. For any symptom please consult a doctor; the Civil Hospital OPD is across the road and we can share nearby clinic timings.

reviews.name: Ritu S., bride
reviews.text: My mehndi was so dark that my masi asked which parlour I went to — and it was done at home, sitting on my own bed! She hid Aman's name so well that he took ten minutes to find it. Totally worth booking her early.

reviews.name: Pooja M., sister of the groom
reviews.text: She did makeup for me, my mother and two cousins on the reception day and still finished before the baraat left. The trial for my bhabhi helped a lot; the final look was exactly what we had agreed. No rush, no drama.

reviews.name: Neha K., Karwa Chauth
reviews.text: Booked a slot on WhatsApp two days before, she came home for our group of four and finished in two hours. The stain was deep red by next morning. Only thing — book in advance, her Karwa Chauth slots go fast.

faq.q: How early should I book for a wedding?
faq.a: Four to six weeks for bridal makeup and mehndi, so there is time for a trial; for peak dates in November, December and February, book two months ahead. An advance of ₹1,000 blocks the date, and we fix the trial at the same time.

faq.q: Do you come home or to the venue?
faq.a: Yes. All bridal, engagement and group bookings are done at your home, hotel room or banquet hall; we bring the complete kit, chairs and lights if needed. Party makeup for one or two people can be done at our studio or at home with a ₹300 visit charge within the city.

faq.q: Which products do you use, and are they safe for sensitive skin?
faq.a: Professional makeup brands for base, eyes and setting, with waterproof and long-wear ranges for brides. Mehndi cones are made by hand with natural henna, eucalyptus and clove oil, no chemical dyes. If your skin is sensitive, tell us at the trial so we can patch-test.

faq.q: When should bridal mehndi be done, and how do I get a dark stain?
faq.a: Two days before the wedding is ideal; the stain darkens over 48 hours. Keep the mehndi on for 6 to 8 hours, dab with sugar-lemon water, avoid water for 12 hours after removing it and apply a little mustard oil or balm. We share the full aftercare on WhatsApp after your session.

faq.q: Can you handle makeup for the whole family on the same day?
faq.a: Yes, with a second artist for four or more people, so the bride never waits. Share the number of people and the time of the function, and we send a schedule so everyone is ready on time.

faq.q: Do you travel for outstation weddings, and how do I pay?
faq.a: Yes, we do destination and hometown weddings outside the city; travel and stay are added to the package and shared with you in advance. Payment is 20 percent advance to block the date, and the balance on the day by UPI or cash.

mla.tagline: Your file, followed till it moves
mla.about: We are the constituency office of your elected MLA, serving every village, ward and colony of the Vidhan Sabha area from one open door in Civil Lines. People come to us for three things: a government matter that is stuck, a development work the area needs, and help in an emergency; the office writes each one in a numbered register, sends it to the right department under the MLA's letter, and reports back to you on WhatsApp till it is closed. Vidhayak Nidhi works, scheme camps, hospital letters and the weekly Janta Darbar are all handled here, free of charge, for every samaj and every party. We publish what has been sanctioned and what is pending, so you can check our work against our word.

offer.title: Gandhi Jayanti to Diwali — Har Gaon Yojana Camp
offer.text: Between 2 October and Diwali the office holds one Yojana Seva Camp in every nyay panchayat and ward: bring your pending pension, Awas, Ayushman or scholarship papers to the camp in your area and leave with the application submitted and a receipt number.

reviews.name: Kamla Devi, Rampur village
reviews.text: My widow pension was stuck for two years because of a bank seeding mistake. At the Yojana camp in our panchayat bhawan the staff corrected it on the laptop in front of me, and the office sent me the approval message on WhatsApp the next month. Nobody asked for a single rupee.

reviews.name: Imran Sheikh, auto driver, Ward 7
reviews.text: Sent a photo of the broken culvert near the madarsa on the office number at night. Got a ticket number by morning, PWD men came within the week, and the office called to ask if it was fixed before closing the ticket. That follow-up call is the difference.

reviews.name: Suresh Pal, gram pradhan, Bhainsa
reviews.text: We applied for a community hall from Vidhayak Nidhi with our gram sabha letter. The office did a site visit, put it in the quarterly list, and the sanction was on their notice board with the estimate. Work took longer than we wanted, but we were told the status every time we asked.

faq.q: How do I contact the MLA office with a problem?
faq.a: Message the office WhatsApp number with your name, village or ward, and the matter in two lines, with a photo if it is a road, water or light issue. You get a register number back the same working day. For anything urgent, call the helpline; for a face-to-face hearing, come to the Thursday Janta Darbar.

faq.q: Can I get a recommendation letter the same day?
faq.a: Yes, when the papers are complete. Bring Aadhaar, your application and proof of the matter (hospital estimate, admission form, connection application) to the letter desk between 11:00 and 16:00, Monday to Saturday. Letters are not issued for court cases, tenders or private disputes, and the desk will tell you the reason if one cannot be given.

faq.q: Which area does this office cover?
faq.a: All villages, wards and colonies of this Vidhan Sabha constituency; the list of blocks and nagar palika wards is on the office board. If your village falls in a neighbouring constituency we will give you the correct MLA office number rather than keep your file.

faq.q: What are the office timings and when is the Janta Darbar?
faq.a: The Seva Desk is open Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 17:00. Janta Darbar with the MLA is every Thursday, 10:00 to 13:00, except when the Vidhan Sabha is in session, when it is held on Saturday; the change is announced on WhatsApp the week before. The emergency helpline runs 24 hours.

faq.q: Is there any fee for letters, forms or Vidhayak Nidhi works?
faq.a: No. Every service of this office is free, including camps, letters and proposals. Nobody is authorised to collect money, commission or 'file charges' in the MLA's name; if anyone asks, send their name and number to the office WhatsApp and it will be acted on.

faq.q: How can I check what work has been done or sanctioned in my area?
faq.a: The office board and this page list Vidhayak Nidhi works by village and ward with sanction date, agency and status. For a specific work, message the village or ward name and the office sends the current status. Pradhans and parshads get the quarterly list on WhatsApp.

Joining the business is completely optional: most of our customers only buy, and the few who ask about the plan get the full picture in one honest meeting, with the work and the rules explained and no income figures promised. reviews.name: Priya S., working mother

faq.q: Are these the company's genuine products?
faq.a: Yes. Every pack is sealed and comes directly from the company's warehouse with its invoice in your name. The batch number and expiry are printed on the pack and you can verify them on the company's website or app.

faq.q: Do I have to join to buy?
faq.a: No. Most of our customers only buy products. Joining the business is optional and we will only explain it if you ask.

faq.q: Can I try a product before I buy a full pack?

faq.q: How much will I earn if I join?

faq.q: What if a product does not suit me?

faq.q: Is the phone sealed and does it come with a GST bill?
faq.a: Yes. Every phone is a sealed box opened in front of you, with a GST bill in your name and the brand's warranty card. We also note the IMEI on the bill for warranty claims.

faq.q: Can I buy on EMI without a credit card?
faq.a: Yes. Besides credit and debit card EMI, we do zero-down-payment finance through a finance company for phones and TVs above ₹8,000. Bring Aadhaar, PAN and a bank passbook or statement; approval usually takes 15 to 20 minutes at the counter.

faq.q: How much will I get for my old phone in exchange?
faq.a: It depends on the model, age and condition. Bring the phone to the shop, or send photos and the model name on WhatsApp for a rough value; the final price is given after we test the screen, battery and camera in front of you.

faq.q: How long does a screen or battery replacement take and is it original?
faq.a: Most screens and batteries are done the same day, usually in 1 to 2 hours if the part is in stock. We offer both original company parts and good-quality compatible parts and tell you the price difference clearly before starting.

faq.q: Will you transfer my contacts, photos and WhatsApp to the new phone?
faq.a: Yes, free with every phone. Contacts, photos, videos, WhatsApp chats and apps are moved, your Google account and bank apps are set up, and the tempered glass and cover are fitted before you leave.

faq.q: Do you deliver and install TVs at home?
faq.a: Yes. TVs are delivered and wall-mounted free inside the city within 48 hours. For nearby villages and towns, delivery charges depend on the distance; message us the location and we will tell you.

ngo.jobTitle: Registered NGO — Education, Health, Women & Elderly Care
ngo.tagline: Help that reaches, with a receipt
ngo.about: We are a registered social service organisation working in the bastis, villages and government-school lanes around Gandhi Nagar and the nearby blocks. Our work is simple and on the ground: evening tuition and school kits for children who would otherwise drop out, monthly ration and medicine support for elderly people living alone, sewing and computer training for women who want their own income, and health and blood-donation camps with local doctors. Every rupee and every bag of rice is tracked — donors get a receipt the same day and photos of where their help went, and anyone can ask to see our registration and accounts. If you need help, want to give a few hours, or wish to sponsor a child, a camp or a kit, one WhatsApp message is enough.

products.desc: A full year's school bag for a child from our tuition centre — bag, notebooks, stationery, water bottle and a pair of shoes, handed over in the child's own hands.
features: School bag, 12 notebooks, pen-pencil set, geometry box

services.desc: Ration, medicines, school fees or a hospital bill — tell us the need, a volunteer visits and we arrange what we can or connect you to the right scheme.

services.name: Women's skill training

offer.title: Diwali Kit Drive — sponsor 5 school kits, we add the 6th
offer.text: Till Bhai Dooj, every sponsor of five school kits gets a sixth kit added by the foundation, and you are invited to hand them over at the centre yourself.

reviews.name: Meera J., homemaker and monthly donor
reviews.text: I sponsor one dadi's ration every month. The volunteer sends me a photo from her doorstep each time and once called to say her BP was high, so they had taken her to the camp doctor. That is the kind of follow-up I had never seen from any organisation before.

reviews.name: Arjun S., engineering student and volunteer
reviews.text: Did my 30-day internship here teaching Maths at the Gandhi Nagar centre. They actually let me run the class, not just click photos. The certificate was accepted by my college and I still go on Saturdays.

reviews.name: Suresh B., garment shop owner
reviews.text: We sponsored a health camp in our workers' colony on my father's barsi. Everything was arranged in ten days, the doctor sat till the last patient, and the report with the patient count came on WhatsApp. Only suggestion: the eye-check queue needed one more person.

faq.q: How do I donate, and will I get a receipt?
faq.a: By UPI, bank transfer or cash at the office. Message us and we send the account details and UPI ID. A receipt with our registration number is sent on WhatsApp the same day, and a printed one is posted if you ask. Tax-exemption status and certificates are shared on request before you donate.

faq.q: Can I choose exactly where my money goes?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a kit, a camp, a meal or a child from the Support page, and the money is used only for that. You receive photos and a short note when it is done. If you prefer, you can also give to the general fund, which pays for whatever is most urgent that month.

faq.q: Can I donate clothes, books or grains instead of money?
faq.a: Yes — clean, wearable clothes, school books for Classes 1 to 10, dry grains, new blankets and working sewing machines. Please message a photo first so we can tell you whether it is needed right now and where to drop it. Torn or unusable items only cost us disposal, so we politely decline them.

faq.q: How can I volunteer, and how much time does it take?
faq.a: Send your name, area and the days you are free. Most volunteers give two to three hours on a Saturday or Sunday — serving the Sunday meal, teaching a class or helping at a camp. Regular teaching slots are weekdays 4 to 6 pm. You are added to the volunteer WhatsApp group and told about the next drive.

faq.q: Do you give internships or certificates to students?
faq.a: Yes. A 30-day internship (minimum 60 hours) in teaching, camp coordination or social-media documentation, with a signed certificate and a short report your college can use for social-work or NSS credit. Message your course, college and the month you are free.

faq.q: I or someone I know needs help — what do I do?
faq.a: Message or call with the person's name, locality and what the need is: ration, medicine, school fee, hospital help or a government scheme. A volunteer visits within two to three days, understands the situation and either arranges help from our side or guides the family to the right scheme or hospital. We never charge for any help, and no one is authorised to collect money in our name.

ngo.address: Seva Kendra, Plot 7, Gandhi Nagar Colony, behind Government Girls School, near Water Tank
ngo.botPersona: A warm, straightforward volunteer who answers questions about donating, volunteering and getting help in simple words, never pressures anyone to give, and treats every request for help with respect.
ngo.botKnowledge: The bot answers about every way to support on this page (school kits, tuition sponsorship, Sunday meals, elderly ration kits, sewing machines, health camps, blanket drive, tree plantation) with the amounts and what each includes; how to donate by UPI or bank transfer and that a receipt with the registration number is sent the same day; which items are accepted in kind and that a photo should be sent first; how to volunteer, the usual time commitment and the volunteer WhatsApp group; the 30-day student internship and certificate; the Wednesday government-scheme help desk and the documents usually needed for pension, Ayushman card, scholarship and ration card; office hours, address and the current Diwali offer. For a family asking for help, it collects name, locality and the need and promises a volunteer visit within two to three days. It shares registration and account details on request, never promises a specific outcome or tax benefit without the office confirming, and never asks anyone to pay for help.

faq.q: Do I need an appointment for the eye test?
faq.a: No. Walk in any time during shop hours; the test takes about 15 minutes. If you want a particular time, message us on WhatsApp and we will keep the slot free.

faq.q: I already have a prescription from my eye doctor. Can you make glasses from it?
faq.a: Yes. Bring the paper or send a clear photo on WhatsApp. We make the lenses exactly to it and only suggest a recheck if the prescription is more than a year old.

faq.q: How long does it take to get my glasses?
faq.a: Zero-power and common single-vision lenses are ready the same day or next day. Bifocal, progressive, photochromatic and high-index lenses take 3 to 5 working days. We message you when the pair is ready.

faq.q: Can you put new lenses in my old frame?
faq.a: Yes, if the frame is not cracked at the rim or hinge. Bring it in and we check it for free before taking the order; if it is too weak we will tell you honestly.

faq.q: What if the new glasses feel uncomfortable?
faq.a: Come back within 7 days. Most problems are fitting, which we adjust free. If the power itself needs correction, we recheck and remake the lenses as per our policy told at billing.

faq.q: How do I pay and do you give a bill?
faq.a: Cash, UPI and all cards accepted. Every pair comes with a printed bill that lists the frame and lens details, which you also need for the warranty on coatings.

reviews.name: Dr. Meenakshi, gynaecologist
reviews.text: Their MR comes on the same date every month, keeps the visit short and always has the calcium and protein samples I ask for. The literature is clear and the composition is printed properly on every strip.

reviews.name: Sunil, PCD partner, neighbouring district
reviews.text: Took the franchise with a ₹30,000 opening order and got the visual aids, pads and samples in the same carton. No target pressure in the beginning, and the net rates have stayed the same for over a year.

faq.q: Which segments and products do you cover?
faq.a: About 120 products in general medicine, gastro, paediatric, ortho, gynae, derma, antibiotics and nutraceuticals. Message "LIST" on WhatsApp and we send the full product list with compositions, MRP and net rates as a PDF.

faq.q: Are your medicines made in a licensed unit?
faq.a: Yes. Every product is manufactured for us at WHO-GMP certified, state-drug-licensed third-party units, and each strip and carton carries the manufacturer's licence number, batch number, manufacturing date and expiry.

faq.q: How does a chemist place an order and how fast does it arrive?
faq.a: Send the order list with your shop name on WhatsApp or to our MR. It is billed by your area stockist and delivered within 24 hours in the city, 2–3 days in the tehsils. Schedule H and H1 items are supplied only against a valid drug licence.

faq.q: What happens with expired or damaged stock?
faq.a: Stock within 6 months of expiry and any transit breakage is taken back by the stockist and credited on your next invoice, as long as the batch belongs to us and the pack is intact. Short-expiry stock is never sent out in the first place.

faq.q: How do I get the PCD franchise for my area?
faq.a: Send your city and tehsil on WhatsApp. If the area is open, we share the agreement, net rate list and inputs policy; you need a drug licence and GST number, and the first order starts from ₹25,000. No sales target for the first six months.

faq.q: Do you supply to hospitals and nursing homes, and at what rates?
faq.a: Yes, we supply hospitals, nursing homes, clinics and health camps directly on institutional rates, with a quotation on letterhead and GST invoice. Minimum institutional order is ₹5,000.

faq.q: What are the payment terms?
faq.a: Chemists pay the stockist on the usual 7-day credit after an account is opened; the first order is cash or UPI. Franchise partners and institutions pay in advance against the proforma invoice, by UPI or bank transfer, and goods are dispatched the same day.

pharma.address: Godown 7, Transport Nagar, behind Krishi Mandi gate, Bypass Road
pharma.botPersona: A courteous trade assistant for chemists, doctors and franchise partners — quick with the product list, rates and dispatch status, and careful never to give medical advice.
pharma.botKnowledge: Office timings and godown address; the product list by segment with compositions, pack sizes, MRP and net rates (sent as a PDF when asked); how a chemist opens an account and orders on WhatsApp; delivery time via the area stockist in the city and the tehsils; running schemes like 10+1 and 10+2 and the new-chemist opening offer; which products are Schedule H and need a drug licence; the expiry and breakage return policy; physician samples and MR visit dates for doctors; hospital and institutional rates and the minimum order; PCD franchise terms — monopoly area, starting order of ₹25,000, inputs included, documents needed; payment terms by credit, UPI or bank transfer; and dispatch or invoice status when the chemist shares the order date. The bot must never suggest a medicine, dose or treatment to a patient — it asks them to consult a doctor and the nearest chemist, and takes trade enquiries only.

photography.jobTitle: Wedding, Portrait & Event Photographer — Studio and On-location
photography.tagline: Every ritual, every laugh, edited and on time
photography.about: We are a photography and film team working out of a studio on Station Road, covering weddings, pre-wedding shoots, engagements, birthdays and baby shoots across the city and anywhere a train or a car can take us. A wedding gets two photographers and a cinematographer so the haldi smear on your cheek and your nani's face at the vidaai are both caught, not one or the other. Every photo you receive is colour-corrected and skin-retouched by hand in our own editing room, never a raw dump on a pen drive, and the online gallery arrives on the date written in your booking slip. Shop owners and home bakers come to us for product, menu and catalogue photos, and walk-ins get passport photos printed and WhatsApped in ten minutes.
highlights: Photo, film and drone, one team

1,200+ edited photos, two 40-page premium albums and a 1-minute Instagram teaser within 10 days

200+ edited photos within 7 days, 25 shared the same night
20-page 8x12 inch photo book included
Cake-cutting and games covered as short video clips on request

reviews.name: Priyanka & Aman, newly married
reviews.text: Our 150 selected photos came on day 6 exactly as written on the booking slip, and the full gallery before the 45 days. The candid photographer got my dadi crying at the vidaai while the other one was still doing the family group photo on stage, which is exactly why they insist on two.

reviews.name: Nitin, home baker
reviews.text: Got 22 cakes shot in one afternoon for my Instagram and Swiggy listing. The white-background cut-outs went straight onto the app without any cropping, and the styled shots with the gold stand and flowers doubled my DMs that week.

reviews.name: Shalini M., mother of a 12-day-old
reviews.text: The studio was kept warm, they waited patiently every time my baby woke up, and the wrap and basket setups looked like the Pinterest photos I had sent. Printed photos came in a week; only wish there was parking closer to the building.

faq.q: What exactly is included in a wedding package and what costs extra?
faq.a: Each package lists the number of photographers, hours, edited photos, albums and films. Travel within 50 km, the online gallery and the USB drive are included. Extra hours are ₹2,500 per photographer per hour, a drone is ₹4,000 per function where permitted, extra albums are ₹6,500 to ₹9,500 depending on pages, and outstation travel and stay are billed at actuals. We send a written quote so nothing surprises you later.

faq.q: When will I get my photos and video?
faq.a: A teaser of 10 to 25 photos reaches you the next day for your status and family groups. Selected photos come within 7 to 10 days. The full edited gallery takes 45 days for a single-day wedding and 60 days for a full wedding; films take 75 days because every song and ritual is edited by hand. The dates are written on your booking slip.

faq.q: Can I see full albums from earlier weddings, not just the best shots?
faq.a: Yes. Visit the studio or ask on WhatsApp and we share two or three complete wedding galleries and a physical album, so you see how we cover the rituals, the family photos and the slow parts of the day, not just the highlights.

faq.q: Do you shoot outside the city or at destination weddings?
faq.a: Yes. Within 50 km travel is included. Beyond that, we add train or car fare and a simple stay for the team at actuals, usually ₹3,000 to ₹6,000 per person per day depending on the place. Udaipur, Jaipur, Goa and hill-station weddings are regular for us; send the venue and dates and we quote the same day.

faq.q: How much advance is needed and what if the date changes?
faq.a: ₹10,000 blocks a Wedding Day booking and ₹30,000 blocks a Full Wedding; smaller shoots need ₹2,000. The balance is paid in two parts, half before the event and half when the gallery is delivered. One date change is free if you tell us at least 30 days before and we are free on the new date; the advance is otherwise adjusted against any future shoot within a year.

faq.q: Can I get passport photos without an appointment, and in which sizes?
faq.a: Yes, walk in during studio hours. We shoot, size and print in about 10 minutes and WhatsApp the soft copy. Indian passport 35x45 mm with white background, US visa 2x2 inch, PAN, Aadhaar, school and government forms, matrimony and biodata photos are all available; tell us the form and we match its exact requirement.

photography.address: 1st Floor, Krishna Plaza, Station Road, opposite Clock Tower, next to the post office
photography.botPersona: A friendly, well-organised studio coordinator who answers package, price, date and delivery questions clearly and moves every serious enquiry towards a call or a studio visit with the photographer.
photography.botKnowledge: Studio timings and Sunday hours, the address and landmark, what the team shoots (weddings, pre-wedding, engagements, sangeet, birthdays, anniversaries, baby and maternity, family portraits, product and food, passport photos), every package with its price, hours, number of photographers, edited-photo count, album size, film length and delivery date, the advance amounts (₹10,000, ₹30,000, ₹2,000) and balance schedule, add-on prices (extra hour ₹2,500, drone ₹4,000, extra album ₹6,500–₹9,500, extra product ₹120, second photographer ₹2,500), travel included within 50 km and outstation at actuals, the date-change rule, how to check if a date is free (send function, date, venue and city), the current early-bird offer, passport photo sizes and the 10-minute walk-in service, payment by UPI or bank transfer with a receipt, and how to request sample galleries. The bot never confirms a date as booked or promises a discount beyond the published offer; it asks for the function, date, venue and a callback number and says the photographer will confirm within a few hours.
