faq.q: How often do RO filters need changing, and what does it cost?
faq.a: On typical city water, sediment and carbon filters every 6 to 12 months and the membrane every 2 to 3 years; on high-TDS borewell water, sooner. A full filter kit with service is ₹2,499; membrane is ₹1,800 to ₹2,800 extra. We note the date and remind you on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Do you service purifiers bought elsewhere or other brands?
faq.a: Yes. We service Kent, Aquaguard, Livpure, Pureit, AO Smith and most assembled ROs. Send us the brand, model and the problem on WhatsApp; a visit charge of ₹300 is adjusted if you take the repair or an AMC.

faq.q: Is EMI available on purifiers and ionizers?

faq.q: Is alkaline or ionized water good for health?
faq.a: We can show you what the machine does to the water: pH, taste and the different modes for drinking, cooking and washing. For any health condition or medical question, please ask your doctor; we do not make health claims.

faq.q: How do I know the products are genuine?
faq.a: Everything comes from the company or its authorised distributor. Imported supplements carry the importer sticker and a scratch code you can verify on the brand's site; herbal products and devices come with batch, expiry and a GST bill. Check all of it at the counter before you pay.

faq.q: Will this product help with my health problem?
faq.a: These are wellness products, not medicines, and we are not doctors. We can tell you what a product contains and how it is taken, but for any health condition, or if you are pregnant or on regular medication, please check with your doctor before starting anything.

faq.q: Do you deliver, and how fast?
faq.a: Yes. Orders confirmed on WhatsApp before 5 pm are delivered the same day within the city; delivery is free above ₹999, otherwise ₹40. Outside the city we send by courier with a tracking number, usually 3–5 days.

faq.q: Can I return or exchange a product?
faq.a: Sealed, unused products can be exchanged within 7 days with the bill. Opened supplements and juices cannot be taken back for hygiene reasons. Devices with a fault go to the company service centre under warranty, and we help you with that.

faq.q: Do you keep refills like glucometer strips and lancets?
faq.a: Yes, strips and lancets for the glucometers we sell are always in stock, and we can order strips for most other brands within 2–3 days. Message us the meter model and we will confirm.

faq.q: I run a gym or a shop — do you give bulk rates?
faq.a: Yes. Gyms, clinics and resellers get bulk pricing on monthly stock, and we do corporate and festival hampers from 10 boxes up. Send us your city and the products you need and we will share the current rate list.

wellness.address: Shop 8, Ground Floor, Shree Complex, Station Road, near City Hospital
wellness.botPersona: Friendly, plain-speaking wellness store assistant who asks who the product is for before suggesting, quotes exact prices, and sends anyone with a health condition to their doctor.
wellness.botKnowledge: The bot can answer what the store stocks and at what price — whey protein and gainers, multivitamins, omega-3, ashwagandha and other herbal capsules, amla, aloe, giloy and wheatgrass juices, chyawanprash including sugar-free, personal care, and devices like BP monitors, glucometers, strips, oximeters and weighing scales. It explains pack sizes, flavours and how a product is usually taken, confirms that stock is authorised with batch, expiry and bill, and shares the ingredient list on request. It takes WhatsApp orders, explains same-day city delivery (free above ₹999, before 5 pm) and courier outside the city, payment by UPI, cash on delivery or bank transfer, the 7-day exchange rule for sealed packs, device warranty and strip refills, store hours and address, Diwali hamper and bulk or reseller pricing enquiries. It never claims a product treats or cures any condition and always suggests consulting a doctor for health questions, pregnancy or ongoing medication.

wholesale.jobTitle: Wholesale Traders — Atta, Rice, Dal, Oil, Sugar, Spices & Packaged Goods for Kirana Stores, Hotels and Canteens
wholesale.tagline: Godown rates, full stock, delivered to your shop
wholesale.about: We are a wholesale trading firm in the city's galla mandi, supplying atta, rice, dal, edible oil, sugar, whole spices and fast-moving packaged goods to kirana stores, departmental stores, hotels, dhabas, hostels and canteens across the city and the tehsil towns around it. Our godown holds truck-load stock of every staple in all the popular brands and pack sizes, so a shopkeeper gets his full list from one counter instead of running to four. Rates are quoted on the day's mandi price with a GST invoice on every bill, and our tempo drops orders at your shop on a fixed route three days a week. Send your list on WhatsApp in the morning and it is weighed, packed and on your doorstep the same day.

offer.text: Book your Diwali quantity of sugar, oil, ghee, besan and dry fruits before 20 October at the day's rate — stock is held in the godown in your name and delivered before Dhanteras with free tempo delivery in the city. Message 'DIWALI' on WhatsApp.

reviews.name: Mahesh, kirana store owner
reviews.text: I have been lifting my full stock from here for three years — atta, oil, dal, biscuits, soap, everything on one bill. The rate list comes on WhatsApp every morning, so I know what I am paying before I order. When a carton of biscuits came crushed last month, the driver swapped it from the tempo on the spot.

reviews.name: Shabnam, hostel mess contractor
reviews.text: We run a 180-bed hostel mess and cannot afford to run out of rice or oil mid-week. They fixed one rate for the month on our staples, drop the order every Monday, and the bill matches the rate they quoted, every time. The 1121 rice is consistently good for our Sunday biryani.

reviews.name: Deepak, new departmental store
reviews.text: Opened my store in June and had no idea what to stock. They made a starter list within my ₹1.5 lakh budget, told me frankly which brands move in our area and which do not, and the first lot came in two days. Only wish Sunday delivery was available, otherwise very satisfied.

faq.q: What do you stock, and who do you supply?
faq.a: Staples — atta, rice, all pulses, edible oil, sugar, jaggery, whole and ground spices, dry fruits — plus fast-moving packaged goods such as biscuits, namkeen, tea, soap, detergent, toothpaste and agarbatti, in all the leading national brands and pack sizes. We supply kirana and departmental stores, hotels, dhabas, sweet shops, hostels, canteens, caterers and institutions. Message your list and we will tell you what is in stock and the rate.

faq.q: What is the minimum order to get wholesale rate?
faq.a: Wholesale rate applies on bag, tin, case or carton quantity — for example one bale of atta, two bags of rice, two tins of oil, or one carton of biscuits. There is no minimum bill value; a small shop ordering five different items at case quantity gets the same rate as a big one. Loose smaller lots of spices and dry fruit start at 5 kg.

faq.q: Do you deliver to my shop, and what does it cost?
faq.a: Yes. Our tempo runs a fixed route in the city on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday; orders received by 8 pm the day before are delivered by noon. Delivery is free in the city on bills of ₹8,000 and above, and ₹150 below that. Tehsil towns and outstation shops are served by transport, with freight added as per the bilty; send your location and we will tell you your route day.

faq.q: How is the rate decided, and does it change daily?
faq.a: Staples follow the mandi — atta, rice, dal, oil and sugar rates move with the market, so we send the day's rate on WhatsApp every morning and bill at that rate. Packaged goods are on a fixed monthly price list with company schemes passed on as received. Hotels, hostels and canteens on a standing order can take one fixed rate for the month on their staples.

faq.q: Do you give credit?
faq.a: New customers start on payment against the bill — UPI, bank transfer or cash on delivery. Shops that have been ordering regularly for a few months can discuss a weekly or fortnightly settlement at the counter. We keep it simple and in writing so there is never a dispute.

faq.q: What if the goods are short, damaged or near expiry?
faq.a: Check the order with the driver when it lands — bags are weighed in front of you on request, and cartons are counted. A torn bag, crushed carton or short item is replaced from the tempo or adjusted on the same bill. Packaged goods leave our godown with at least 5 months to expiry; if you find otherwise, send a photo on WhatsApp and we take it back.

hours.time: Mon, Wed, Sat by noon; order by 20:00 the day before
